tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa gsang 'dus bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ /maṅga laṃ// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra dharma swa mi gu h+ya sa mā dza ye na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje chos kyi rje gsang ba 'dus pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod khro rmongs pa'i nyon mongs ma spangs par/ /thabs mkhas lam gyis byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /pha rgyud sde gsum nang nas 'dus pa yi/ /rgyud rgyal gsungs pa'i ston pa phyag gi gnas/ /de lta'i zab rgyas chos tshul la brten nas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba bsam yas kyis/ /'phags pa'i yul du gsang gsum 'dus pa yi/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad paṇa grub mchog rnams bsngags/ /khyad par dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs lugs 'di la/ /bka' drin gzhan las che ba'i skye dgu'i mgon/ /'gran bral rnams la lan brgyar phyag bgyi 'o/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'dus pa'i chos tshul rnams/ /'phags yul skad las bod skad du bsgyur nas/ /'gro la chos sbyin stsol mdzad skad gnyis pa/ /'gos sogs lo chen rnams la bdag cag dad/ /de lta'i bla med pha rgyud bshad srol sogs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /bla chen kun dga' snying po yab sras dang / /chos rje khu dbon zhabs zung spyi bos mchod/ /skyes chen de dag bzhed gzhung bshad pa dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas phyogs brgyar spel ba la/ /brgyud 'dzin gzhan las mdzad pa phul byung ba'i/ /kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang por phyag byar 'os/ /gzhan yang mus chen sems dpa' chen po dang / /kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po seng ge'i mtshan/ /de sogs 'dus pa'i rgyud dang man ngag rgyun/ /spel mdzad bod yul mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams rgyal/ /phyis dus sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku/

/ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes grags pa'i/ /mdzad pa bzang gang la bsam kyang yid 'phrog pa/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma che der snying nas 'dud/ /mgon de'i thugs sras grub mchog dbang po dang / /yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan/ /rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed po mus pa rje/ /snying nas dran no rtag tu shis pas skyongs/ /chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam rol can/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /chos bdag gdong bzhi gnyan por gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyal gyi/ /don 'grel khog phub sngon med nyi ma 'di/ /blo mig dag pa'i mkha' las spro 'gyur gyi/ /skal bzang zhal gyi pad+mo 'dzum par byos/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa gsang 'dus bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ zab mo'i mthar thug dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de ltar byung ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub dngos bshad pa/ zhar las 'ong pa rgyud bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bshad bya rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag 'chad byed lam srol gyi byung tshul/ bshad bya'i don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya la gzigs nas/ phar phyin theg pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis gsungs pa las/ dang po yang gdul bya'i dbang gis grub mtha' bzhi sde snod gsum theg pa gsum du gnas shing / gnyis pa la yang rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs gang zag gi rim pas gsang sngags thams cad rgyud sde bzhi ru bsdus nas gsungs/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus nas rtog pa dang /

bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces pa lnga ru gsungs pa la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub pa phal che ba ni gsang sngags thams cad rgyud sde bzhi ru bsdud pa la mi mthun pa med pa nyid yin te/ gong gi lngar gsungs pa de yang / rtog pa'i rgyud ni las tshogs gtsor ston pa la dgongs nas zur du bgrangs pa yin gyi/ ngo bo bya rgyud dang gcig yin no/ /zhes rje btsun rtse mos gsungs so/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud ni rgyud sde gzhan 'ga' zhig tu spyod rgyud la gsungs pa yod kyang 'dir yo gar bzung zhing / rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud do/ /don 'di lta bu la dgongs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / rim lnga'i sgyu lus kyi skabs rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su/ rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas pa zhes so/ /spyi rnam du rje btsun rtse mos/ gnyis ka 'phags lugs la yod par gsungs pa'o/ /de dag gi nang nas 'di ni rnal 'byor chen por 'du ste/ de la yang gsum/ thabs gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ thabs shes gnyis ka ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud do/ /dang po la yang gdul bya 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba 'dod chags kyi rnam 'phrul gtso bor ston pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor/ gti mug can gtso bor 'dul ba gti mug gi rnam 'phrul gtso bor ston pa rnam snang sgyu dra'i chos skor/ zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba zhe sdang gi rnam sprul gtso bor ston pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor gsum las 'di ni dang po ste/ de la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ji tsam cig bzhugs snyam na/ kha cig na re/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bcur bzhed de/ de'ang rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/

dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhi zhus/ rdo rje phreng ba/ rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ rnam snang sgyu dra'o/ /zhes zer ro/ /der ni ma nges te/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa ni sgron gsal du lung drangs pa tsam las bod du yang ma 'gyur bas/ mdo rgyud gang yin yang mi gsal mod/ e waṃ ma ya'i bshad pa byung bas rgyud yin du chug kyang / lung drangs pa tsam gyis de'i bshad rgyud du mi 'grub ste/ sgron gsal du e bam̐ ma ya la phan pa tsam zhig rgyud gzhan du yang mtshungs pa sogs skyon du ma yod do/ /gnyis med rnam rgyal ni che chung gnyis yod pa las che ba ni po ti long pa tsam zhig yod de/ rgya pho ba lung pas byas pa yin la/ chung ba rgyud yin kyang rnam snang sgyu dra dang mthun pa tsam las/ 'phags lugs la bshad du phan pa'i shes byed ci yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam snang sgyu dra ni sngar smos pa ltar pha rgyud rang rkang thub pa gcig yin gyi/ 'di'i bshad rgyud ma yin te/ grub chen kun snying gis 'di gnyis rtsa bshad du sbyar nas sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs yo gar bkral tsam ma gtogs/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub sus kyang le'u bcu bdun pa'i bshad rgyud du sgyu dra sbyar nas/ spyir bla med khyad par 'phags lugs su bkral ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs la ni 'phags lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang po lnga dang / ye shes zhabs lugs la bshad rgyud phyi ma gnyis sbyor bar bzhed mod/ 'phags lugs la yang rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa 'di zhal gyis bzhes dgos pa 'dra ste/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis rgyud phyi ma 'di gsang 'dus kyi rgyud yin par bshad pa gang zhig de'i rtsa rgyud ma yin pa'i phyir dang / rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa'i dka' gnas thams cad dri ba lnga bcu rtsa bzhir bsdus nas dris pa'i lan thams cad/

le'u bco brgyad pa 'dis gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ gsang ba 'dus pa thams cad kyis kyang bshad rgyud du zhal gyis bzhes dgos pa 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'phags pa yab sras kyis bshad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chings dang / rgyud phyi mar gsungs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chings gnyis mi mthun pas/ 'phags lugs kyi bshad rgyud du sbyor ba mi rigs so snyam na/ skyon med de/ yab sras kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi 'ching tshul der/ le'u bco brgyad par bshad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi 'ching tshul de 'dus pa yin te/ de'ang bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings par yan lag bzhis bcings par 'dus pa dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lngas bcings par 'dus pa dang sbyor ba yan lag drug gis bcings par 'dus tshul zhib tu sgron gsal le'u bcu gnyis par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gsum dang rim pa lngas 'ching ba ni rtsa rgyud la rdo rje 'phreng ba sbyar ba'i dgongs pa ste man ngag go /de ltar 'phags lugs la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud lnga'am drug tu bzhed pa'i rtsa bshad sbyor tshul ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun btus las rgyan bdun gyi bshad thabs sogs bstan/ dgongs pa lung ston gyis rtsa rgyud kyi stod kyi tshig re re la yang mtha' drug tshul bzhir bshad/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyis rdzogs rim gtso bor ston/ rdo rje phreng bas dbang chog phal che ba dang / bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching tshul dang / rdzogs rim gyi chings rim pa lnga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs sum cu rtsa gnyis su byed pa sogs bstan/ rgyud phyi mas gong du smos pa ltar dris lan lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams bstan te sbyor tshul shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa 'chad byed lam srol byung tshul la gnyis/ rgya gar du byung tshul dang / bod du byung tshul lo/ /dang po la srol chen bdun tsam snang ba las/

dang po srol rnams kyi rgyal po ltar gyur pa 'phags lugs byung tshul bstan pa la gnyis kyi/ gzhung ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub rang gis rtsa rgyud le'u bdun las btus nas/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i lha so gnyis kyi sgrub thabs ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings pa'i gzhung mdor byas zhes bya ba dang / de nyid rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar zhing lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdud pa sogs ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig kha skong ba'i tshul gyis sgrub thabs mdo dang bsre ba zhes bya ba ste bskyed rim gyi gzhung gnyis/ rdzogs rim rim lnga dang / byang chub sems 'grel gnyis te bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bzhi mdzad cing / yang des mdzad do zhes snga rabs pa rnams gsungs pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ de la phyis kyi mkhas pa dag 'di ni klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang mi mthun pa mang po 'dug pa'i phyir ro gsungs pa la/ gzhan dag na re/ de ltar dpon slob kyi gzhung 'gal byung na/ slob ma'i gzhung the tshom can du byed pa rigs kyi/ slob dpon gyi gzhung the tshom can du byed pa mi rigs so/ /zhes zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ dkyil chog gnyis po de'i nang nas klu byang gi dkyil chog ni rgya gar ba'i paṇa grub mang pos tshad ldan du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir te/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su/ grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis spel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa las shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / a bha ya dang kha che paṇa chen la sogs pas tshad ldan du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dkyil chog dang po de klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa yin na/ klu byang dang sgra gcan 'dzin gyis de'i rjes su de dang mi mthun pa'i dkyil chog re mdzad pa don med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dang po the tshom can du grub bo/ /de'i sras kyi thu bo ar+ya dā+e was/

sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa bsam pa la bslab pa nas 'bras bu'i bar gyi/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim rdzogs par ston cing / khyad par rdzogs rim gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung / le'u bcu gcig gi bdag nyid spyod dus sgron ma zhes bya ba dang / de'i sems dben la 'phros nas sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus la 'phros nas bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang / 'od gsal las 'phros nas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa ste gzhung bzhi mdzad do/ /grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis rdul tshon la brten pa'i bum dbang yan chad kyi dkyil chog nyi shu par grags pa/ mdor byas sbyang gzhi dang sbyor ba rnam gzhag rim pa zhes pa dang / rdzogs rim rim lnga khongs bsdu zhes bya ba ste gsum mdzad de/ phyi ma la kha cig 'di the tshom can yin te/ rim pa re re'i nang du yang rim pa lnga lnga byas pa'i phyir ro gsungs par grags te/ de ni theg pa chen po'i lugs la chos re re'i nang du yang chos thams cad 'dus par bzhed pa ste ches khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /gal te de lta bu la skyon du byas nas mi 'thad na/ phar phyin drug re re'i nang du phar phyin drug drug gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /yang grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog dbang bzhi char tshang ba zung 'jug gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad de/ klu byang gi dbang chog la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang dbang gong ma gsum 'di nas kha bskong ba yin no/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis ni sngar gyi rim lnga'i mjug bskyangs pa tsam las gzhan ma mdzad de/ de dang rim lnga'i/ srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa yan chad slob dpon gyis mdzad cing / de man chad slob mas mdzad nas shākya bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'o zhes 'byung ste 'di la 'khrul nas/ kha cig shākya bshes gnyen klu sgrub kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'dod pa ni ma brtags par smra ba'o/

/de ltar yab sras lnga'i gzhung rnams kyi rgyab rten du/ dgongs pa bskong ba'i slob ma zla ba grags pas/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /gnyis pa de dag lam gyi rim par sgrig tshul la/ spyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim ni/ dang por sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa zhes bya ba byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ theg pa gsar pa la bslab pa zhes bya ba smin byed kyi dbang bskur te/ dran pa gcig pa zhes bya ba bskyed rim bsgom pa'i mthar lus dben sku rdo rje/ ngag dben gsung rdo rje/ sems dben thugs rdo rje sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa/ 'od gsal don dam bden pa zung 'jug dang bcas pa la rim gyis slob pa yin la/ de dag rdzogs par ni spyod bsdus sgron mes kyang ston mod/ gzhung so so'i dbang du byas na/ klu byang gi nyi shu pa dang zung 'jug gsal bas smin byed kyi dbang bstan/ mdor byas mdo bsre rnam gzhag rim pa dang gsum gyis bskyed rim bstan/ de nas lus dben gyi mtshams sbyar te rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni rim pa lngas bstan cing / gzhung phran gzhan rnams ni de dag gi 'phros gzhung yin pa dang / sgron gsal ni thams cad kyi rgyab rten yin tshul gong du smos pa bzhin no/ /lam srol gnyis pa ni slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs yin te/ slob dpon des le'u bcu bdun pa la rgyud phyi ma dang rdo rje snying po rgyan sbyar nas/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum po de la brten nas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso bor byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs dang / rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le la sogs pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi mdzad/ de lta bu'i slob dpon de yang rgya gar shar lho'i yul/ sin+dhu ra zhes bya bar/ rgyal po gha pa ro pra bha ba zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs so/ /de byis pa nyid nas gzugs dang /

shes rab dang / kun tu spyod pa rnam par dag par gyur nas/ sgra dang / sdeb sbyor dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa la rab tu mkhas par sbyangs so/ /cher skyes pa dang / rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas/ na len+d+ra'i phyogs gcig tu/ grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya bar/ rgyal po shrī dharmā pā las brtsigs pa/ tṛka zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad bzang po'i slob ma/ thugs rje dang / byang chub kyi sems la goms pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab du ma'i mdzod 'dzin cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gsal bar 'chad pa slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i drung du pha rol du phyin pa'i gzhung lugs sbyangs nas/ shrī na len+d+rar rigs ldan yon tan bshes gnyen gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rtsom pa dang / bshad pa sogs byas nas/ der gnas pa rnams brod pa bskyed do/ /de nas byang phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du byon te/ yul de'i phyogs gcig na slob dpon nor bu'i gling du skyes pas nor bu gling pa zhes kyang bya/ gzugs sna tshogs su ston pas sna tshogs gzugs zhes kyang bya/ 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes kyang bya ba de'i drung du/ bya ba dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang du gsan/ de nas yul de'i phyogs gcig na gu ni ru zhes bya bar grags pa'i bla ma de'i drung du bsnyen te/ lung mang du gsan no/ /yang yul de'i phyogs gcig na lak+ṣa me se na chen mo'i drung du/ zla ba brgyad kyi bar du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsan te der 'phags pa gnod gnas kyis grub pa thob bo/ /de nas dza len ba rar/ ba mo pā ta ste/ slob dpon byis pa chung ngu'i zhabs zhes bya ba shes rab kyi rgyud la bsam pa chu klung lta bur gyur pa'i drung du shes rab kyi rgyud mang du gsan no/ /de nas lho phyogs nam mkha'i shing ldan kong ka nar pa liṃ pā ta ste/

slob dpon srung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba/ thabs kyi rgyud la bsam pa chu klung lta bur gyur pa'i drung du lo dgu bzhugs te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud chen 'grel bcas bco brgyad bar du nyan ces gsungs te/ bla ma'i dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud chen ni rnal 'byor rnams so/ /'grel bcas ni rnal 'byor legs par bslabs pa sme sha can gyi bu mo/ bi la mu tra ste de dang bcas pas zla ba bco brgyad kyi bar du nyan par gsungs so/ /de'i tshe bla ma'i zhal nas bdag gis don 'di ma rtogs zhes gsungs/ de la thugs cung zad chad de/ 'di ma rtogs na gzhan don med snyam nas phyag rgya 'dus pa'i glegs bam du byas nas mgul par btags te/ rdo rje gdan kyi byang phyogs ku ba tsa zhes bya ba stag dang / dred la sogs pa mang po gnas pa'i tshal du byon te/ zla ba drug bsgoms pas de kho na nyid rtogs so/ /de nas ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'jol sgeg rol pa dang bcas pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sprul pa'i dge slong bla ma gnyis dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi khang pa chung ngu zhig tu snang bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba 'jam pa'i lung gsungs zhes pa 'di tsam zhig zhal lung las 'byung la/ gtam rgyud gzhan las ni bla ma ba liṃ pā ta'i zhal nas khyod kyi the tshom gyi mdud pa de dag rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'jam pa'i rdo rje bzhugs pa'i drung du zhus shig des grol bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas byon pa'i lam khar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su khang bu zhig gi drung na/ bud med gcig dang / khyi mo zhig gnas pa dang / de dang nye ba na btsun pa zhig chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing rmod cing 'dug pa gzigs pas/ kyai ma rab tu byung ba bud med dang bcas zhing rmod pa 'di 'dra ba byung bas bstan pa nyams so snyam du dgongs nas thugs skyo bar gyur to/

/de lta na yang nyi ma'i dus bab pas der byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa des bud med la rab tu byung ba 'di la gro drongs shig ces bsgos pas/ bud med des nya rgya khyer nas/ chu phran zhig la nya bshor te/ de btsos nas khyi mo'i mdun du shing lo la bzhag nas chos ston drongs zhes bsgos pas/ khyi mo skyug pa dang / der sngar gyi nya dang bcas pa drangs pas slob dpon gyis ched du dmigs pa'i sha dang / mi gtsang bar dgongs nas ma gsol lo/ /de nas btsun pa na re kyai 'dzam bu'i gling pa la phal pa'i zas byin ces bsgos pas/ 'bras chan zho dang bcas pa drangs pa dang / slob dpon gyis gsol nas yang gshegs par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa de na re da 'di na phar song yang / do nub sdod sa mi rnyed pas sang song zhig zer bas der bzhugs so/ /der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa zhal ton du bton pa dang / gang du slob dpon gyis ma shes pa'i sar/ bu med des mi mgu ba dang / ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur re byas pa dang / slob dpon gyis 'dis the tshom chod par 'gyur ram snyam du dgongs te/ phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa dang / bud med na re ngas mi shes/ da ci'i btsun pa de shin tu mkhas pa yin pas de la zhus shig zer ro/ /der gar song dris pas chang nyor song zer/ bsgugs pas phyi ma red chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin par 'ong ba gzigs pas/ ma dad kyang nga rgyal bcag nas phyag 'tshal te/ bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa bshad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur longs shig ces gsungs/ bdag gis dbang bskur thob ces brjod pas/ nga nyid kyis dbang bskur dgos zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis yo byad btsal nas dbang zhus so/ /der ston zla rwa ba'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo spyil po gzhal med khang du sprul/ de'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa mngon sum du bstan nas dbang zhus zhes pa snang ngo /

/lo rgyus gzhan las ni sngar gyi btsun pa de yang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'dug nas nga la dbang len nam/ dkyil 'khor la dbang len zhes gsungs pa la/ dkyil 'khor la dbang len zhus pas dkyil 'khor mi snang bar gyur nas/ der dkyil 'khor btsun pas sprul pa yin par dgongs nas phyag 'tshal te/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor sprul pa la tho rangs dbang blangs zer ba yang ma dag pa 'dra ste/ zhal lung las/ mgo dang lag gnyis yol dang tshe brgyad rgyal la bab/ /ston tha 'bring po'i tho rangs skya rengs shar dus su/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa las/ /bdag gis don 'di blang phyir gsol ba rab tu btab/ /khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa tsam las mi snang yang / de'i 'grel par de nas dge slong gis gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog la gnas par shes nas de las spyan ras kyis btsal ba'i phyir btsal ba'i phyir 'jam dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul lo/ /tshes gang zhe na/ mgo dang lag gnyis yol nas tshes brgyad rgyal la bab/ ces so/ /nam la gang zhe na ston zla ra ba zhes so/ /der sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bla ma la mos pa dris pa dang / sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par dka' gsal ba dang / dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa de nyid du khang pa chung ngu zhig gi nang du bzhugs so/ /de nas bla ma chen pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor la de bzhin nyid blang bar bya ba'i phyir gsol ba 'di skad du btab bo/ /khyod ni zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na 'grel pa 'dir dkyil 'khor sprul pa yang tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs sprul par gsungs shing mjug tu zhal gyi lung gnang zin nas skya rengs shar ba'i tshe sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa mi snang bar gsungs pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul ma thag tu gsol ba btab nas gdams pa gnang bar gsal lo/

/gtam rgyud de ltar 'chad pa ni sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bla ma la mos pa dris pa dang / sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par shes nas dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa de nyid khang pa chung ngu zhig gi nang du zhugs zhes pas 'khrul gzhi byas par snang yang / de'i don sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la mos par shes pa'i tshe dge slong bla ma dang bcas pa sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i sar bzhugs nas dkyil 'khor dang tha dad du snang la/ bla ma la mos par shes na sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid dge slong bla ma bcas pa der byon nas tha mi dad du snang zhes pa'i don to/ /gtam rgyud snga ma ba liṃ pā tas lung bstan nas ri bo rtse lngar 'gro ba'i lam khar de ltar byung bar bshad pa yang cung zad ma dag pa 'dra ste/ zhal lung las/ rdo rje gdan rgyab kun pa tsa zhes bya ba'i tshal/ /stag dang dred sogs mang zhig 'jigs pa'i sar/ /zla ba drug tu gnas nas chos rnams de nyid rtogs/ /sprul pa'i dge slong bla ma gnyis dang bcas dang phrad/ /mgo dang lag gnyis yol dang zhes sogs sngar drangs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang zla ba drug song ba'i mthar sngar bshad pa ltar gyi sprul pa gsum po dang 'phrad nas/ zas dang spyod pa la cung zad ma dad pas btsun pas dkyil 'khor sprul te/ btsun pa de dang / khyi mo dkar mo dang / bud med ngan ma bu chung ngu dang bcas pa gsum po yang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du gnas pa la gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas lung thob par gsal te/ zhal lung las/ sprul pa gsum po de ltar du gnas pa yang gsungs shing / mjug tu/ khyod kyang zas kyi bya ba dang / /nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /gtam rgyud kha cig las/ tshig bcad 'di dag btsun pas bshad par gsungs pa yang ngo bo gcig pa la 'gal ba med kyang rnam pa'i cha nas de ltar ma yin te/ zhal lung gi 'phro nyid du/ khyod kyang zas kyi bya ba dang /

/nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /khyod kyi tshe 'di nyid la ni/ /gzugs bcas phung po rang lus ni/ /gnas ni yang dag mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par shes pa mi bshig la/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu 'grub/ /de bas khyod kyi yang dag blos/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /gsang chen gsang la rab gsang ba/ /gong na med pa'i lung chen po/ /'di yi rim pa dang po yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs dang sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma sna tshogs 'khor lo dang / /bsdus pa dang ni rnam bshad dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga la sogs pa/ /mi shes mun sgrib sems can gyi/ /thur ma lta bu brtsam par gyis/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de la sgrub pa'i thabs ni kun tu bzang mo gsum mo/ /sbyin sreg ni gnyis kyi cho ga'o/ /gtor ma ni mi nub pa'i sgron ma'o/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo ni tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /bsdus pa ni rin po che 'bar ba'o/ /rnam bshad ni ma mdzad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni nyis brgya lnga bcu pa zhig mdzad de/ bla mas rgya dpe kha cher khyer nas yul dbus kyi slob ma rnams kyis ma mthong bar grag go /sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa rtsa ba'i ye shes chen po/ tshigs su bcad pa mdzod grol ba'i ye shes/ bdag nyid grub pa 'byung ba/ byang chub sems kyi thig le dpal bkra shis kyi rnam bshad chen mo/ bzhi pa la 'jug pa'i thabs dang bcas pa/ nor sbyin dbang po'i sgrub thabs te/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad do/ /de dag gis slob ma'i tshogs la phan btags pa'i nang nas rgyal tshab kyi sa par 'os pa'i gang zag bco brgyad/ de'i nang nas mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gang zag mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje bde ba chen po ste bzhi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni bla ma chen po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin pas mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i rjes su 'brang bar sman pa'i zhabs kyis bshad do/

/bla ma chen pos rnam bshad ma mdzad pas rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa mdzad pa'i slob ma bcu gsum byung bar grags shing / rjes 'jug la yang sman pa'i zhabs dang / dpal 'bras rdo rje dang / tsi lu pa dang / tha ka na la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang du byung ste/ srol bla na med pa'o/ /srol gsum pa ni slob dpon shan+ti pas rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog ces bya ba mdzad pa yin te/ slob dpon 'dis slob dpon sman zhabs dang rgyal sras sa 'dres pa gnyis la zhus pa yin kyang / de gnyis dang mi mthun pa mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i lha nyer lngar byed pa dang / lta ba sems tsam du bkral ba sogs grub mtha' du ma yod do/ /srol bzhi pa ni paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ tis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rang 'gyur du mdzad pa zhig yod pa de yin te/ de'ang bla ma bzang po'i zhabs la zhus pa yin/ lam srol lnga pa ni shan+ti pa'i sku tshe smad tsam la/ sha ba la nas dus 'khor byung ba'i dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan gyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba de yin te/ de'ang dus 'khor gsang 'dus ltar bkral ba ni ma yin gyi/ gsang 'dus dus 'khor ltar bkral yin te/ dus 'khor ba'i bzhed pa las gsang sngags thams cad dus 'khor ltar 'grel bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /srol drug pa ni slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gling bzhi ma rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba gcig yod do/ /lam srol bdun pa ni grub chen kun snying gis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa la byed do/ /de'ang slob dpon 'dis ni rgyud 'di dang rnam snang sgyu dra dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams yo gar bkral ba'i lugs yin no/ /gnyis pa bod du lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/

bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ paṇ+ḍi ta shra dha ka ra warma la/ lo chen rin bzang gis spyir gsang sngags khyad par 'dus pa rnam gnyis zhus shing / de'i nang nas kyang gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis ka'i dbang bka' sogs zhus kyang / 'phags lugs ni da lta chad nas med do/ /de'i sku tshe mjug tu jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i dus/ ghar dge ba rab gsang la 'dus pa'i dbang khrid bshad bka' gnang ba ni ding sang med la/ 'jam rdor gyi rigs pas spyan gzigs gtso bor byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bka' sogs gnang ba ni deng sang yang bzhugs so/ /lha bcu dgu po de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan la rigs lnga yum bzhi khro bo bzhi ste bcu gsum las med kyang / gling gzhi nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje ma drug bsnan pa la 'dod cing / gtso bor 'jam rdor dang spyan ras gzigs kyang 'khor gyi sems dpa' der bcug pa ni ma yin gyi/ rang rkang ba re logs nas spyan drangs pa yin par bzhed la/ de'i tshe rigs lnga ma tshang ba'i nyes pa'ang med de/ 'jam rdor gyi tshe mi bskyod pa rigs bdag tu bteg cing / spyan gzigs kyi tshe dpag med rigs bdag tu bzhugs te/ de'i shul du mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa yin no/ /yang bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas rgya gar du ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma la ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang bka' gsan pa yang deng sang sa skya pa la bzhugs so/ /yang jo bo rje phebs pa'i rjes su/ bla chen 'brog gis rgya gar du byon te rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas par mdzad nas phebs te gsang ba 'dus pa rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can la gsan pa yin yang / deng sang chad nas med do/ /de'i sku tshe'i mjug tsam la de'i drung du rje 'gos kyis sgra dang / gzhung phran tshegs mang du bslabs/ khyed la ma rgyud kyi gdams ngag zab la mang ba brda ba gda' bas/ bdag la gnang bar zhu byas pas/

gser khyer la shog gsungs/ yul du phyin zhing rnams btsongs pas gser mang po byung / gser 'bul dgos pa snyam pa la rgya gar la phyin na dga' zhes sa skya pa rnams zer ro/ /'brog mi'i drung nas 'gro khar bla ma'i bid par ta'i dpe brkus te byon/ phyis 'gos la mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos chos gsan du byon pa'i tshe/ 'brog mis 'gos ngan pa nga'i bid par ta brku ba la chos nyan pa khyod la dam tshig med gsungs pa'i 'phrin gnang ste/ mnga' ris pas bshags pa phul zer/ 'chad lugs gcig la khong 'khrungs yul rta nag pa gdung rus chen 'gos kyi brgyud pa yin pas 'gos/ lcam sring gnyis 'dus pa'i bu yin pas khug pa/ de nas rta nag phu yi lhas ra gcig tu btsar phyin pas lhas btsas/ cher skyes nas 'ug pa lung du zur pa la rnying ma slob tu btang bas/ rnying ma ba rnams khong la sdang bar byung bas ngas rgya gar du phyin la chos gcig bslabs la khyed la gcig bya yi zer/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang 'grogs te rgya gar du byon/ de dus na mkhas pa sgo drug ni grongs tshar nas mi 'dug gsang 'dus slob dgongs/ su mkhas dris pas sa ḍes pa'i slob ma rnams drag zer/ shan+ti pa dang dpal sbas ni mi bzhugs/ gzhan mngon shes can dang btsun mo can rnams la gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams zhus/ bod du byon/ de tsam na mdo khams nas khams pa mar ston seng ge rgyal bya ba nor chen po yod pa gcig gtsang du byon/ 'jad kyi lung pa stong par yod pa der bsdad tsa na 'gos dang mjal/ chos zhus/ nor mang po phul nas rgya gar du brdzangs/ de'i res la mngon shes can gyi gral nag po dam tshig rdo rje la 'dus pa'i bshad pa rgya chen po dang / phyag len phra mo tshun chad mkhas par bslabs/ de ltar rgyud gsung dus bla ma de gsum gyi gsung sgros spyi dang bye brag so sor ma 'dres par bris pa rgyud kyi mchan chen po khyad par du 'phags pa dang rim lnga'i khrid so so la zhus pa la yang shog ril so sor byas pas shog ril gsum mdzad/

gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can la yang chos mang du gsan te/ 'di paṇa chen ga ya dha ra dang yang gcig ste/ 'gos 'gyur kha cig tu paṇ+ḍi ta sprin gyi shugs can rgya gar shar phyogs kyi kong ka la'i rgyal bu/ gā ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas zhes bshad/ lo chen rin bzang gi dbang sngon ma rang zhu sa kha che khri brtan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra ha ri la yang chos zhus/ 'di bya spyod la shin tu mkhas pa gcig yin par 'dug cing / khong gi grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag ston pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa yod pa las mngon rtogs ljon shing du lung drangs pa 'byung / gzhan yang bal yul rdzong gi na ka ko ti zhes kyang zer/ zhi ba bzang po bya ba dang / bal po mthil gyi tsa hung rgyal po'i khab kyi mkhas pa chen po dza hu bī ka ma la shi+ā la'i thams cad mkhyen par grags pa dī paṃ ka ra/ sa ra ha la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis te/ mkhas pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis la mdo rgyud man ngag mang du mnos shing / rgya gar shar nub thams cad bskor bas paṇ+ḍi ta skad sna mang ba rnams kyis kyang skad sna bdun brgyad tsam las mi shes pa la/ rje 'gos kyis rgya gar shar nub kyi skad sna mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis mkhyen/ lā+o chen rin bzang gi 'gyur yod pa rnams la 'gyur bcos ma mdzad/ sgron gsal la dbyar khral cung zad bgyis zer ba'i sgron gsal dbyar khral ma bya ba la ding sang rtsis che bar byed do/ /bod du byon te rtsa bshad lnga'i nyams len mngon par rtogs pa stong thun chen mo zhes bya ba dang / rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel sgron gsal gzhir bzhag pa la/ bla ma mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa gsum po'i bshad srol thun mong ba dang / nang gses mi 'dra ba so sor ma 'dres par rtsa rgyud kyi steng du mchan du bkod pa/ 'dus pa'i mchan chen zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos khyad par can mdzad/ gzhan yang khong pa bla ma bsam pa bzang po zhig yin par 'dug pas/

man ngag thams cad yi ger bkod/ bshad nyan la rtsal bton pas rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung phran theg pa bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las la mkhas pa lcam slob ma zhig gis lha min thag bzang ris kyi bu mo rig ma la bkug pa'i lo rgyus yod do gsungs so/ /dang gral ma gshibs pa lta bu shin tu mang bar byung ngo / /ka chen bzhi ni/ glan grags dbang / mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sum ston ye 'bar/ mi nyag dharmā tsan+d+ra'o/ /gdung bzhi ni/ rngog dge ser ba/ dbus pa dga' 'bum/ lho rdo rje snying po/ dmyal gyi dro nye ba mgar chung chos kyi shes rab dang bzhi'o/ /ka chen bzhi'i nang nas bgres shos glan grags dbang yin te/ chos ni mahā ma ya las gzhan tsam mi shes pa yin gsungs/ de la mang ra la sogs pa bu tsha gzhon pa rnams kyis rgan pa rnams la lha phyag kyang gsum gsum 'bul skad/ dge bshes mang ra ni bu tsho rnams kyi nang nas bla ma la zhabs tog che zhing shes rab shin tu che bas 'phags pa yab sras kyi chos dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro kho na'i gdams ngag la mkhas/ sgron gsal gyi bka' mchan la sogs pa yig sna du ma mdzad/ khong rdog gi tsha'o yin te/ yum rdog gi dge tshe ma/ yab mang ra ban chen bya ba yin/ khong gis bla ma la gser g.yu la sogs pa'i nor mang po phul zhing / khyad par gnag khyu chen po yod pa thams cad zho dong dang sbra khyi tshun chad lcam me phul/ yab kyis 'o skol lha g.yag 'di mi 'bul byas pas/ khong na re bla ma la 'bul ba la lha g.yag bya ba gang na yod/ bla ma nyid lha yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rje'i thugs zin nas 'phags skor gyi gdams ngag thams cad ma lus par mkhyen no/ /de la gshong rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ brang ti rgyal le la sogs pa'i bu slob mang du bzhugs kyang / rdog chen po ye shes seng ge zhes bya bas khams nas 'jad du byon/ khong mang ra'i zhang po yin pas nga'i zhang po yin gsung zhing thugs rtsis chen po mdzad de/

rgyud gdams pa ma lus par tshang ba yin skad/ rdog shes rab che bas bla mas gsungs pa'i chos la mi zin mi srid/ zin pa thams cad la ngas yi ger ma byas pa med gsungs skad/ khyad par rje 'gos kyi stong thun las/ mngon shes can gyi lugs zur du phyung ba stong thun 'bring po mdzad/ rim lnga'i sgron me/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi sras rdog nyi ma seng ge dzam bha la 'grub pas longs spyod shin tu che zhing / ma rgyud mahā ma ya dang / pha rgyud la shin tu mkhas pas slob ma mang du 'dus/ sku btsun par byed cing na bza' yang lus la snal ma 'khri mi myong bar gos dar 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pas/ rdog shākya mu ne zhes grags/ des de dus yan la 'gyur ba'i 'phags lugs kyi gzhung rnams la sa bcad dang ṭīk+ka mdzad/ khyad par rgyud kyi stong thun shog bu mda' tshad bcu tsam byas pa'i stong thun chung ba bya ba dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad mdzad pa la sgron chung ming bdud rtsi tshim byed du grags/ ye shes seng ge'i yig cha rnams sa skya sgo rum na dpe 'dug dar rgyu med/ nyi ma seng ge'i tsho shin tu dar zhing legs pa'ang yod/ zur du sras gcig byung ba/ sku btsun pa'i grags pa che bas mis ma tshor bar byas/ mdo smad du bskyal lo/ /mdor na brag stag gi rdog nyi ma seng ge la mu ner grags pa des/ bres chu bar gyi rlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam can du byon zer/ der phyin pas 'dus pa rdzogs par gnang / bla ma 'dis sngar gyi bla ma gong ma'i 'grel dkyus su bcug sngon dus rdog pa yab sras kyi gsung sgros la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris byas pa bstod 'bum smad 'bum bya ba'i stod smad la po ti re re ste/ po ti gnyis yod pa zhig nas gsung sgros rgyas par bsnan pa'i 'grel bshad sgron chen de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i ṭīk+ka gcig bo dong se sgom gyis kyang mdzad/

zhes bya ba mdzad/ gsang 'dus la mkhas pa'i grags pa chen po thob ste/ rdog ār+ya dā+e wa zhes grags/ ya ra la wa tshun bzhir bshad pa zhes pa yang mdzad/ des sa skyar chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku drung du byon te sa skya pa'i chos lugs kyang mang po gsan/ /khong pas kyang sa skyar 'dus pa la sogs pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ sa skyar byon pa la sa thag ring pas lam stegs la bya ru gzhung sa paṇa gyis gnang / des na sa paṇa gyi slob ma zhang bya ru ba zhes grags/ sa paṇa gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa yang gzhal yas khang gi tshad la sogs pa du ma yod do/ /de gong du 'gos rdog pa rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog re ma gtogs dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rgyas par byed pa'i srol med pa la khong gis sa skya pa la lag len bde ba mig shugs khyer nas 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ dkyil chog mchod phreng sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad do/ /'gos rdog gi bla ma gong ma rnams sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa rgyun du mdzad pas bskyed rim sgom tshul de'i zhar la 'ong ba/ rim lnga'i khrid rgyun du bsgom zhing / dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ dkyil chog rgya gzhung dang stong thun la brten pa ma gtogs bod kyis mngon dkyil brtsams pa yang med cing / mang po tshogs nas sgrub mchod kyang mi mdzad do/ /de la skyin khar dben tsha'i rtag pa rin chen grags dang / rong lha steng gi gtsang smra seng dang / cha dkar mon mo brag gi mi nyag rdo rje grags gsum gyis gsan/ yang rdog nyi ma seng dang / rlan rtsad tsha yab sras gnyis ka la/ snye mo gzhu'i phug ka ba phug ston shes rab grags 'bum skyabs zer/ kyis gsan/ de la yang mi nyag rdo rje grags dang / gtsang smra seng gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyis ka la nyang stod srib chung gi lce ston mdo sde seng ges zhus/ yang rlan rtsad tsha la rgyang khar thang dpe ba'i mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs kyis zhus/ de la gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od kyis gsan/

rtag pa rin chen grags kyis rdog ār+ya dā+e wa'i zhar chos pa yang mdzad cing / de dang lce ston mdo sde seng ge dang / gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od gsum ka la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan/ de la kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtshos gsan/ de la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub kyis gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes pas 'dus pa'i bdag por gyur cing / gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos 'byung / sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad/ sgrub dkyil la sogs pa'i yig cha mang du mdzad do/ /de'i sras kyi thu bo dam pa mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa gcig gi drung du/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ 'dus pa'i rgyud/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ 'grel bshad mtha' drug rab gsal/ dbang bka' rgyud ma mang po'i bka' bab phyogs gcig tu dril ba dang / sgrub thabs dang rgya gzhung mang bo'i bshad pa/ rim lnga'i sgom khrid dang bcas pa rgya cher gsan cing / de'i drung du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud kyi bshad pa tshar gsum dang / dbang bka' dang sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa sogs mtha' chod par gsan pa yin la/ rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid kyi brgyud pa/ rlan tshad tsha yan sngar bzhin la/ mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston rin po che/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ de'i drung du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan zhing / sa lugs kyi dbang bka' rnying pa zhes grags pa/ rje 'gos kyi slob ma/ gdung bzhi'i nang tshan/ dbus pa rngog dge bshes ser po/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ yang na bsod rtse'i gnas su kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ de nas chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros bstan pa/

dpal tshul ba/ de'i drung du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan pa'i thugs 'dun cher mdzad kyang / bla ma gshegs nas gsan ma thub pa la phyis grub chen bud+dha shrī la gsan no/ /sa lugs kyi dbang bka' gsar pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zla grags nas/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par bzod pa'i lha/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇa chen man rnying pa ltar ram/ yang na sa paṇa/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u pa dar she se mo ra pa rin chen dpal/ bla ma ra gnyis pa rin rgyal/ spro lung kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od man chad bshad bka' dang 'dra ba las/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan drung du/ ngor chen gyis gsan no/ /gzhan yang gsang 'dus mar lugs su grags pa'i bka' srol chen po byung ste/ rje mar pa lo tsā bas dbus kyi lho brag nas rim gyis mu gu lung du bla chen 'brog mi'i drung du sgra mkhas shing skad byang bar bslabs/ sngags kyang cung zad zhus/ zhabs drung du lo gcig bzhugs pa la rgyud dang gdams ngag ye ma gnang nas/ lho bal du lo tsā la gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs byung ba bla mas dgongs te/ 'brog bla chen gyi zhal nas/ lo tsā ni mkhas par khyod rang gis shes/ da rgyud dang gdams ngag zhu ba la khyod kyis sngar gyi zhabs tog gis cung zad mi yong pas na yul du song la rgyags 'thug pa longs la shog yang na khyod rang gis phul ba'i rta 'di yang phar sbyin gyis/ gser du tshongs la bal po tsam du chos zhu ba la dka' las ci 'dug tshod lta ba la song dang / de nas gdod nga la yang gus pa drin du gzo ba zhig yong las che gsungs/ der bla ma mar pas sngar khong rang gis phul ba'i rta nag po seng ge kha gdangs zhes bya ba de slar zhus nas/ zab chen bubs gcig seng ldeng rta sga gcig dang gsum stag ris su 'tshong du phyin pa las gser srang nyi shu khugs nas/

dge bshes klokya chen pos grogs mdzad de/ rim gyis rgya gar du byon/ snga ma res la lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa yin/ mar pa'i gsung las/ kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'di/ /skyes pa lho brag gi ting du skyes/ /bag chags mang mkhar gyi phyogs su sad/ /dpal mu gu lung gi dgon pa ru/ /sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la/ /sgra dang klog skad kyi yig tshang bslabs/ /khong sku drin mi chung che bar khums/ /zhes gsungs/ spyir rgya gar du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste bdun/ shar nub/ lho byang / kha che/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang / sku sa la grags tshad la bla ma brgya rtsa/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs te/ gsung mgur las/ chos smon lam gyis 'brel pa bcu gsum bzhugs/ /khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bzhugs/ / bal po spyi ther ba/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba bzang po/ gha gha mai tri ba/ na ro paṇa chen dang lnga'o/ /rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bzhugs/ /gtso bo dpal chen nā ro pa/ /de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa/ /zhes pa dang / zhabs pad spyi bor reg mdzad cing / /gsung don bdud rtsi rjes gnang pa/ /chos 'brel tsam gyi bla ma yang / /dpal sing ga gling pas sna drangs pa/ /snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun gyi nang nas/ 'dus pa'i dbang dang / rim lnga dmar khrid/ rgyud rkyang pa'i/ kyi bshad pa hril tsam/ dpal na ro pa la nos shing / khyad par nub gu la k+ṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang du gnas pa dpal ye shes snying po las/ 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud gdam pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bka' babs te/ nub gu la k+ṣe tra'i grong khyer du/ /dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la gtugs/ /pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nyan/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi dam tshig thob/ /lam rim pa lnga yi don la bslabs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rim lnga'i dmar khrid yod pa la a cang che ste/

ma gtogs pa'i/ /rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na mar pa nas/ rim lnga'i khrid dang / rgyud kyi bshad bka'i brgyud pa la/ grub thob nyams rgyud dang / mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i rgyud lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas byung ba ste/ rang gi slob ma rngog gzhung pa chen po la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams las/ 'dus pa'i dbang lung bshad bka' dang khrid bka' sogs/ sngon gyi dus su dar rgyas su byung zhing / dol gyi 'tshur don dbang gi rdo rje la rgyud rkyang pa dang / dbang gdams par bcas pa'i bka' bab pas/ des 'khon gad pa kirti/ des me nyag thur lha ba/ dbus pa 'gar dge sogs las rgya cher 'phel bar bshad do/ /kha cig gis/ mar lugs 'di dang / klu sgrub kyi rim lnga gnyis bsres nas 'khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa byas pa ni/ bka' srol dang lam rim gyi khyad par tsam yang ma phyed pa'o/ /gnang phyag lo dang lcal mo sogs nas brgyud pa byung mod/ deng sang ni chad nas mi snang ngo / /de ltar bod du gsang ba 'dus pa'i srol 'dzin pa du ma byung yang / srol 'dzin rnams kyi rgyal po ni 'gos yab sras rnams su shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa de ltar ngos bzung gi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud de dag lam srol de dag gi bshad pa'i brjod bya'i don gtan la dbab pa la/ 'dir gtso bor 'phags pa yab sras kyi bzhed pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud don thams cad don bzhir bsdus nas 'chad de/ de yang rgyud 'di la dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'jug tu rung ba'i rten gyi gang zag des blang dor gyi dngos po yongs su shes pa'i spyod yul/ des nyams su blang bar bya ba gnyen po lam gyi rim pa/ des blangs pa las byung ba 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po ni gsung rab spyi nas bshad pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag thun mong ba rnams kyang 'dir 'jug mod/ 'di rang nas bshad pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag ni lngar mdzad de/

ut+pal lta bu'i gang zag pad ma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag pad ma dmar po lta bu'i gang zag tsan+dan lta bu'i gang zag rin po che lta bu'i gang zag go /de la gang zag dang po'i mtshan nyid ni gsum ste/ thos pa che ba/ don zin pa/ de ma thag tu tshig don gnyis ka brjed pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid kyang gsum ste/ dang po gnyis gong ltar la/ tshig don gzhan la ston mi nus pa'o/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid dad pa che ba/ snying rje che ba/ thos pa che ba/ thos don de ma thag brjed par 'gyur ba ste bzhi yin no/ /gang zag bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ lnga ste/ thos pa chung ba/ nga rgyal che ba/ don gyi rtsa ba med pa/ tshig gi spros pa mang ba/ don gang zag gzhan gyis zin par mi nus pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid la bdun te/ tshul khrims dag pa/ mkhas pa/ sgrin pa ste khong grung ba/ shes rab che ba/ rgyud gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ thos pa che ba/ don gzhan la ston nus pa'o/ /'o na de lta bu'i gang zag lnga char gyis rgyud 'di la nyan bshad sgrub gsum byar rung ngam snyam na/ nges pa med de/ de la gang zag dang po dang gsum pa gnyis kyis ni bag chags tsam bzhag pa'i phyir du nyan du rung gi bshad sgrub byar mi rung ste tshig brjed nas med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dang bzhi pas ni nyan pa dang bsgrub par rung gi bshad par mi rung ste dang pos tshig don ston mi nus shing / gnyis pas don bstan kyang zin mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag lnga pas ni thams cad rung bar shes par bya'o/ /gang zag 'di dag gi mtshan nyid rgyas pa ni/ 'og rgyan bdun pa'i skabs su 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa des blang dor gyi dngos po yongs su shes par bya ba'i spyod yul ni bden pa gnyis te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o/

/zhes gsungs pas spyir theg pa chen po'i lugs la shes bya'i gtso bo thams cad bden pa gnyis su 'dus shing / khyad par rgyud 'dir dang por bden pa gnyis so sor bstan nas/ mthar thug zung 'jug tu grub pa 'bras bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag cung zad cig brjod na/ re zhig bden gnyis so sor bstan pa dang / mthar thug bden gnyis dbyer med du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi dang po kun rdzob bden pa'i ngo bo ni/ 'dir rlung sems tsam ste/ de yang byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po rlung gi bzhon pa can de thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i dbang gis phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang zhing zhen pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phar phyin theg par phyi rol gyi snang ba la kun rdzob bden par bzhag kyang / 'dir de'i 'khrul gzhi rlung sems tsam la 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rlung sems tsam de mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sgyu lus su grub pa'i tshe/ snang ba thams cad de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so/ /zhes shes par bya ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dgongs pa yin par ma rtogs pa kha cig gis dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin par sbyar nas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba lta zhog gi sgrub pa po rang gi lus kyang bzhag nas/ de las logs su rlung sems tsam las mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku 'grub par 'dod pa ni ches 'khrul ba'o/ /gnyis pa don dam par bden pa'i ngo bo ni/ thog ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba gang du yang mi dmigs shing / nam mkha'i dbyings ltar gnas pa de yin te/ rtsa rgyud le'u bco lnga pa las/ byang chub sems dpas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos ni gang la gnas/ gang la byung bka' stsal pa/

lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje las byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems rdo rje las byung ngo / /nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' gang la gnas/ gang la yang mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs shing / byang chub sems kyi le'u rigs lnga'i byang chub kyi sems so sor gsungs pas kyang 'di ston pa yin no/ /de yang rang gi ngo bo 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi so so rang rig pas gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis nyams su myong ba tsam yin yang / gdul bya dman pa rnams kyis rtogs pa'i don du/ tha snyad tsam du gcig du bral la sogs pa'i sgo nas dbu ma pa'i gzhung lugs ltar gtan la 'bebs par byed do/ /'di rdzogs rim du nyams su len pa'i tshe na sgyu lus kyi 'og gi 'od gsal gyi ngo bo nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa bden gnyis dbyer med du bsgrub pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang po spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral yang rang gi ngo bo mi 'dor bar zung 'jug tu gnas pa yin kyang / glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ma shes pa de/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyis so sor shes par byas nas ngo bo zung 'jug tu byed pa yin no/ /de yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam gnyis/ /so so'i char ni shes gyur pa/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par des bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa de nyams su blang bya gnyen po lam rim la/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs pas/ smin byed kyi lam dang / grol byed lam gnyis/ smin byed la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / smin byed kyi lam dngos so/ /dang po la bzhi/ rgyu'i rkyen khyad par can/ bdag po'i rkyen khyad par can/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can/ dmigs pa'i rkyen khyad par can no/ /dang po ni/ gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/

de yang sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pas rgyud sbyangs te/ 'di'i dbang bskur zhing dam tshig 'bogs par 'os pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ de'ang slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni rgyud tha dad nas mang du gsungs kyang / 'dir rnam snang sgyu drwa las/ brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo rgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de ni slob dpon yin zhes bya/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sngags/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de yang rang bzhin rgyud kyi khyad par dang / 'dus byas pa yon tan gyi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis bstan cing / gnyis pa ni de'i 'og ma gsum gyis bstan la/ rkang pa rjes ma gsum ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byas pa ste/ de la bzhi/ sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba'o/ /dang po gsum ni go sla la/ bzhi pa dam tshig pa bri ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ de la mchod pa bya ba/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa ste bzhir gnas so/ /bzhi pa ni slob dpon gyi mchog mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de slob ma la bstan par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la dbye na bka' rnying ma ba rnams kyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gsum du 'dod/ klu byang gis/ slob ma'i don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgya bri bar bya/ /rin chen de bzhin sa bon dang /

/me tog tshon dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma g.yo dang phye ma dang / /de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden/ /zhes brgyad du gsungs te/ de yang rin chen ni rin po che'i tshon gyis bris la/ sa bon ni 'bras la sogs pa'i phye mas bris pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /me tog ni go sla/ tshon ni rtsi tshon gyi ras la bris pa/ bra ma g.yo ba ni rang bzhin zhib pa'i bye ma dkar po tshon gyis kha bsgyur bas bris pa/ phye ma ni cong zi la sogs pa zhib par btags nas kha bsgyur bas bris pa/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor ni ting nge 'dzin gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar sprul pa/ bden pa'i dkyil 'khor ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor te/ de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor drug ras bris kyis dkyil 'khor gcig lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang brgyad yin no/ /gnyis pa smin byed dngos la/ bka' rnying bas bzhir mdzad de de yang dam tshig dang sdom pa phog pa/ slob ma gzhug cing dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ dbang bskur ba/ sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pa'o/ /snga rabs pa de dag phal che bas/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nas bde mchog gi dbang dang 'di'i dbang gi chings bstan pa gnyis so sor ma phyed par/ 'dir yang mi bskyod pa chu dbang du byas pa ni yab sras kyi gzhung dang 'gal te/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i chu dbang gi skabs su/ de nas rtag par bsam la zhes rnam snang du bsgom pa dngos su bshad cing / nyi shu pa chu'i skabs su mi gsal yang / ming dbang gi skabs su/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin bsgoms nas/ /zhes mi bskyod par bshad pas/ rnam snang chu dbang du 'grub la/ sgron gsal le'u bcu drug par yang rnam snang chu dbang sogs su rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bka' gsar pa 'di pa'i lugs la ni/ klu byang gi bum dbang yan chad la zung 'jug gsal ba'i dbang gong ma gsum dang sgron gsal gyi skabs 'ga' zhig gis kha bskangs nas smin byed kyi lam 'don pa yin te/

de'ang dkyil chog nyi shu pa'i sdom gyi rim pa bzhin mdzad pa las/ sdom ni/ dang por sa ni sbyangs pa dang / /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang / /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang / /thod lo bkor gyi thig gdab dang / /de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol btab dang / /phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang / /nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang / /tshon rtsi rnams ni dge ba dang / /lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang / /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang / /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang / /lha dang bla ma'i yon gnyis dang / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang / /dkyil 'khor las byed phur bu dang / /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /rab mchog cho ga nyi shu yi/ /ji lta ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin te/ de'i cho ga dang po bcu gcig ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba yin la/ de nas bdun ni slob ma la bya ba yin zhing / rjes ma gnyis mjug gi bya ba yin par shes par bya ste/ de dag gi lha rnams spyan drang zhes pa'i skabs su sgron gsal le'u brgyad pa'i bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub tshul sbyar/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur gyi skabs su sgron gsal le'u bcu drug par bshad pa'i lus dkyil dang nang dbang byed tshul rnams sbyar/ rjes gnang gi mjug tu zung 'jug gsal ba'i dbang gong ma bskur tshul sbyar bas 'phags lugs kyi dbang mchog yongs su rdzogs pa gcig 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam ni bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/

/de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la thun mong ba'i bsnyen pa dang / mchog gi bsnyen pa zhes bya ba'i tha snyad kyang bya ste/ de nyid las/ thun mong mchog gi bye brag gis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /tha mal pa ni rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rdo rje bzhi ni/ dang po stong pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /gzhi pa la ni yig 'bru bkod/ /ces pas bstan pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yin la/ ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni rjes dran dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug go /de'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi po de rgyas par bstan pa'ang / de nyid las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /nye bar sgrub pa sgrub chen po/ /rdo rje'i skye mched thams cad nyid/ /sngags kyi bdag po bsgom pa na/ /sgrub pa'i tshe na bskul bar gsungs/ /sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag sam/ /rdo rje rnam snang 'di dag gis/ /tha mal bsgrub pa'i bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ yan lag bzhi po 'di kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs pa dang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs pas ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs bzhi la sbyor la/ 'dir ni dang po'i mgon po bskyed pa sogs bzhi la sbyor ro/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs la thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis bskyed rim kyis thun mong sgrub pa dang / rdzogs rim gyis mchog sgrub pa zhes gsungs pas thun mong ba'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la bskyed rim dgos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ bskyed rim gyis thun mong tsam las mchog mi 'grub pa ni ma yin te/ bskyed rim ni gzugs sku'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis po de la yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas te/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs/ /zhes sogs bskyed rim sngon du song ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ ngag dben nas brtsams te rim pa lngar mdzad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgron gsal du/ bskyed rim la rim pa gcig tu byas nas lus dben dang ngag dben du bsdus te rim pa lngar mdzad/ 'phags pa lhas spyod bsdus su/ rim pa dgur mdzad do/ /de yang sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa/ theg pa gsar pa la dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rigs kyi dbye bas lus rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ ā li kā li'i bdag nyid ngag rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i kun rdzob sgyu lus la bslab pa/ ril por 'dzin pa dang rjes su shig pa'i rnam pas don dam 'od gsal la bslab pa/ mthar bden gnyis zung 'jug la bslab pa'o/ /de la de dag gi dang po ni byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas dbang gi snod du rung bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bskur te dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim la dran pa rtse gcig pa'i bslab pa'o/ /gsum ni phra thig rnal 'byor la bslab pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sbyang gzhi thams cad rigs brgyar phye nas de sbyong byed kyi lha so gnyis yang rigs brgyar phye ste bsgom/ de la goms na rigs lngar bsdus nas bsgom/ de'ang goms pa na gsang chen rigs bzhi gcig tu bsdus nas thugs rje lta bu bsgom pa'o/ /de lta bu'i lus dben 'di 'phags pa klu sgrub dang slob dpon gyis rim pa gang gi khongs su bsdud kyi gsal kha ma gsungs kyang / 'phags pa lhas skabs 'dir bsgom par gsungs pa la/

snga rabs pa rnams bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad mod/ 'di rang gi ngo bo ni bskyed rim gyi phyogs su gtogs te/ sbyang gzhi lha zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa tsam las rlung la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdu ba'i tshe na rdzogs rim gyi phyogs su bsdu dgos te rdzogs rim sgom pa'i tshe 'di la lha'i rnal 'byor nges par dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum po rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas par nam shar gyi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /drug pa ni snang mched thob gsum gyi rim pas gnyis snang gi rtog pa rnam dag gi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /bdun pa ni gong gi dben pa gsum gyis bsgrub pa'i rdo rje gsum po de mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgrub pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni sku de la yang bden 'dzin gyi dri ma cung zad yod pa rnams 'od gsal stong nyid du sbyong ba'o/ /dgu pa ni de ltar 'od gsal stong pa nyid las langs pa'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo can du byed pa'o/ /de ltar rim pa lnga dang dgu la sogs par phye yang / nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo la rim pa gnyis su 'du la/ de lta bu'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i rtsa bar gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i le'u bco brgyad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba zla ba grags pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel mdzad mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad bka' lung dang bcas pa kho bo cag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis don gnyer che ba las kyang ches che ba bgyis nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang /

gsang ba'i bdag po/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ shākya bshes gnyen/ ār+ya dā+e wa/ klu byang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon nag po pa/ sa ḍes pa chen po/ paṇa chen mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ dam tshig rdo rje/ sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po 'gos lo tsā ba/ mang ra seng rgyal/ rdog ye shes seng ge rdog ar+yā de wa/ rin chen grags/ gtsang smra seng / mi nyag rdo grags/ lce mdo sde seng ge phug ston 'bum skyabs/ rgyang mkhar thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gzhon nu 'od/ bar skabs kyi brgyud pa dgyes pa kun 'dus pa ma ngag pa chen po/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bu ston rin chen grub/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ de gnyis ka la bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rje byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na bu ston pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na bu ston/ lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rje rdo rje 'chang man gong dang 'dra/ yang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud 'grel chen sgron gsal dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya dā+e wa/ tā+ai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ tshul dbang nge / 'khon gad pa kirti/ mgar ston jo sras/ ang phug ri ston/ seng ge rdzong pa/ khyung ston zhig po/ mkhan po tshul snying / chos sding mkhan po rdo rje snying po/

chos sding pa 'og ma/ shrī zur phug pa dar ma bzang po/ mkhan po bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇ+ḍi ta/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge chos rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje dpal ldan don 'grub/ rje ga ga na bud+dha/ bik+ṣu paṇ+ḍai pa/ de las bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thos pa lags so/ /de lta bu'i 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyid 'chad nyan gyi skabs su/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nyid kyis phyag len gyi rim pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ de yang rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyis rgyud bshad gnang dus kyi phyag len gsung rgyun dri ma med pa bkod pa'i yi ge dag las 'di ltar 'byung ba yin te/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi tshogs khang du rje btsun kun dga' bzang po sgo nang du phebs tsam nas yig brgya gsungs te/ khrir bzhugs nas nyer gcig tsam kun gyis 'dren/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bsngos nas sku bsrangs te mgo 'dren 'di skad gsungs pa yid spro bas bri bar bya ste/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / gnas khang srung 'khor gyi dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gnas 'og min du bsam pa dang / chos ston pa'i bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje drug pa rdo rje 'chang shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /

khyed rang rnams dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la thugs mnyam par bzhag nas chos nyan pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / ston pa la nang du yang dag 'jog pa'i dus dang / snyoms par 'jog pa'i dus dang / chos 'chad pa'i dus rnams las/ gsung gi 'phrin las chos 'chad pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di'i tshig gi 'phreng ba rnams dang / don rtogs par bya ba rnams ni chos phun sum tshogs pa ste/ phun tshogs pa lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir rgyud sde rnams kyi nang nas ches zab pa dang rgya che bar gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud sde gzhan nas/ dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag la/ brtul zhugs mthar thug sangs rgyas thod/ /las tshogs mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /zhes che bstod mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'chad par byed pa lags/ 'di la bshad srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs bzhin 'grel bar byed/ de la 'di 'chad byed kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba ni rtsa bar gyur pa yin la gzhan 'phags lugs kyi 'grel pa bzhi tsam yod pa ni/ de'i yan lag tu gyur pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i 'grel chen 'chad par byed pa la/ rgyud 'grel gyi byung tshul rnam par gzhag pa dang / de ltar byung ba'i rgyud 'grel dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdog pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams yan chad du byung tshul bla ma'i rnam thar gyi zhar la cung zad tsam bstan pa ma gtogs/ zur du phyogs 'byams yi ger bkod pa med la/ de dag gi rjes su rlan tsad tsha nyi ma lcam gyis mdzad pa'i sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad du byung tshul bris pa rnams khong pa gsang 'dus la sbyangs pa che bas 'dus pa rang gi chos skad ngo bo shin tu bzang mod/ gzhan gsung rab spyi la sbyangs pa chung ba tsam yin 'dra bas thun mong gi brda chad ci rigs pa dang /

gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos skad mang du bkod pa yod pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag de'i rjes su bu ston rin po ches rgyud 'grel gyi byung tshul/ rje btsun rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam la gzhi byas/ der gsang 'dus kyi byung tshul shin tu rgyas par bkod pa zhig mdzad na yang / rgya ches pa dang / dbang rgyud dang / bshad rgyud kyi rim pa sna tshogs yang ni snang / legs cha yang shin tu mang mod/ skabs 'dir de yang btang snyoms su bzhag 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams rgyud sde gang 'chad kyang / de dag gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gzhung tshad mar gyur pa rnams la brten nas byung tshul mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang de dag dang mthun par spyir sde snod rnams tshul gsum du dbye ba/ bye brag gsang sngags kyi theg pa rnam par dag pa/ de las kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i byung tshul lo/ /zhes sogs la 'phros nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang 'grel ba 'grel bshad man ngag gi chos skor sogs rgya bod du byung tshul bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa dang bcas pa zhib tu gsungs nas/ spyir bla med kyi rgyud 'grel go ba la bskyed rdzogs kyi brda chad legs por chags dgos pas/ ding sang chos thun gcig la bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang / rim lnga'i khrid 'chad par byed de/ yang 'dus phyis bran nas slob bya ba yin gsungs/ pa gzhung phran gyis 'chad bya ba yin pas/ bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs ston pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdor bya ba/ de rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba mdo sde/ bskyed rim gyi dka' ba'i gnas 'grol ba klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa/ mdor byas kyi yan lag tu nag po pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog mngon shes can gyi gtor chog rnams 'chad cing / rdzogs rim la 'phags pa'i rim lnga nyid dang / de'i sems dben gyi skabs su 'phags pa lha'i sems kyi sgrib sbyong / klu byang gi las mtha' rnam 'byed/

sgyu lus kyi skabs su 'phags pa lha'i bdag byin brlabs pa'i rim pa/ 'od gsal gyi skabs su 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi byung ba sems 'grel/ 'phags pa lha'i mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ rim lnga spyi la phan pa la rim lnga khongs su bsdu ba klu byang gis mdzad pa/ sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi lam rim rnams kyang ci nus su 'chad la/ khyad par lam mtha' dag ni gzhung shing dang / rdzogs rim gyi spyi khog spyod pa gsum dang bcas pa rgyas la gsal bar ston pa slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me rnams rim gyis ston pa lags/ de dag gis ni rgyud 'grel 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa dang byung tshul bstan zin pa yin/ dngos gzhi rgyud 'grel nyid sang dgong nas mdzad par zhu ste zla ba gsum tsam dgos so gsungs shing / de'i sang nyin nas rgyud bshad dngos gzhi tshugs par mdzad pa'i der skabs rje rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gsung rgyun rnams thugs zin gyi sras mchog dngos slob srad pa kun blos zin bris su bkod pa'i legs bshad kyi yi ge las 'byung tshul cung zad brjod na/ de yang / dpal gyi chos grwa chen po e waṃ chos ldan du rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po pa dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa/ srad pa kun blo rang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa chu mo bya'i lo gsar shar ba nas/ dgun dpyid zla ba bzhi'i bar du rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gsungs pa la/ sngon du zla ba gcig tsam gyi ring spyi'i byung tshul rgyas pa gcig gnang ste/ bdag gis gang zin tsam gcig bris yod la/ de nas snga chos la bskyed rdzogs gzhung phran dang bcas pa gnang zhing / dgong chos la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas bar gsungs/ tsha rting ma'i gsol ja'i thog tu bskyed rim kyi bshad pa gsung dus bu ston rin po che'i mdor byas kyi ṭīk+ka la snga gzigs re mdzad nas/

ja grol ma thag snga chos gsung du byon pas/ tshogs su chos rim la rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyer gcig re/ gsang 'dus nyid kyi gtor chog ltar 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngos mdzad nas chos gsungs te bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'gos rdog gi bzhed pa gtso cher rang lugs su bzhag nas/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa res 'thad pa dang / skabs su sun 'byin dgos pa yang snang zhing / phyis kyi 'dus pa la sbyangs shing mkhas par rlom pa dag gi rtog btags la dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ rang lugs kyi sgrub byed du sngon 'gro dang / lhag mos lta bu'i don tshan re song rim gyis nyid kyi rang lugs 'phags pa'i bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir mdor bstan/ de yang rgyud kyi lung gi sgrub pa dang / mdor byas su cung zad kha bskong dgos pa yang yod pas mdo sde/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud kyi srid pa'i rim pa ltar sbyong byed ston pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa rnams kyi 'bru snon/ rgyas bshad/ dka' gnas rnams lung rigs man ngag gi sgo nas zhib par ston cing / zla grags kyis mdzad zer ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyang bshad pa dang bcas par gnang / rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslabs nas/ bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar du/ spyod bsdus las 'byung ba'i bslab tshigs ring mo rgyas par gsungs/ de dus snga gzigs la rje 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo/ shog dril gsum/ 'gos kyi gsung sgros yig sna dang bcas pa mdzad nas rim lnga 'gos lugs de las kyang paṇ+ḍi ta btsun mo can gyi shog ril la thugs rtsis su mdzad do/ /gzhan mar lugs la dmigs pa'i byed lugs 'di ltar yod do/ /zhes dmigs rkang tshang bar gnang ste/ bu ston gyi khrid yig dben pa gsum 'gos lugs gtso la/ bden gnyis mar lugs rang du yod cing /

zung 'jug gnyis ka ltar yod ces gsungs pa las/ dgag sgrub cher mi mdzad/ ding sang gi 'dus pa bar grags pa rnams kyi gsung la yi ger bris pa la nor ba 'di 'dra yod cing / nged kyis gsung gleng gi sgo nas rtsad bcad pa la 'di 'dra yod do zhes phyogs snga rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa longs pa'i dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga dang / 'phags pa'i spyod bsdus la bshad pa rgyas pa mdzad/ gzhan gzhung rnams la lung bshad pa tho re ba gnang / de'i tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas che la 'gag don 'gril ba/ sun 'byin sgrub byed nus pa che la tshig ris gtsang ba/ nyams len sems thog tu 'khyer bde ba gnang bas/ srad pa kun blo'i slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po don yod dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ snga chos de gsan rjes byams chos gsungs pa'i chos grwar nyin re bzhin chos rje rin po che'i/ de ring gi chos thun de gcig po'i mkhas pa'i khyad par/ dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag nyams len la sbyor tshul/ ye rang tsho'i yon tan phyogs gcig tu gril ba la med gsungs/ chos thun yang 'tshams par byung bas dgyes par mdzad/ gung ja'i bar la rje 'gos kyi tshan chen la snga gzigs mdzad cing / res 'ga' rdog pa'i 'grel bshad kyang gzigs nas/ dgong chos la sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod rgyan bdun gyi stong thun rnams la/ sngon la gzhung thog tu mi gzigs par skam bshad rgyas pa re mdzad/ de nas bu ston rin po che'i mtha' drug rab gsal gyi steng nas bshad pa dang 'bru snon/ lung tshun chad yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa mdzad rjes/ mang ra'i dka' mchan dang / rdog dang rlan gyi ṭīk+kar/ de 'dra'i nyag nyog mang po mi byed par go rgyu che la tshig nyung ba'i hril pa 'di 'dra re byed pa yin gsungs nas/ snga rabs pa'i lugs kyi bshad pa rno thag chod pa re mdzad de/ dper mtshon na sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod bshad par dam bca' la/

bu ṭīka na bshad yams rgyas la/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs bskyar gyin mang po bris pa de gsungs rjes su/ snga rabs pa rnams 'di 'dra'i go rgyu chung la zer rgyu mang ba mi byed/ rgyud tshig la bzhi bshad dgos pa du ma 'byung yang / bstan bcos kyi 'bru snon la bzhi bshad byed pa ci 'dra yin ma shes/ 'di la mang ra seng rgyal 'di ltar gsungs te/ bshad do zhes sbyar/ gang bshad na/ dpal ldan rgyud rgyal zhes dang / rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa bshad/ gang gis bshad na zla ba grags pas bshad/ sngon du bya ba ci byas nas bshad na/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la btud de bshad/ tshul ji ltar 'chad na rnal 'byor rgyud kyi shin tu gsal bar rnam phye legs bshad pa/ mtha' drug gis ni 'ching ba bcings te bshad/ snod gang la bshad na/ rgyal sras yul gyur te dbang rnon skal ldan la bshad/ slob dpon su'i man ngag la brten nas bshad na/ de ni klu sgrub las rnyed pa de lta bu'i man ngag la ma brten na bshad par mi nus te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas kyi rgyas btab ces sbyar/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pas na dpal ldan no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ni gsang 'dus so/ /gang 'dus na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa'o/ /khyab pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis so/ /bdag ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du gyur pas so/ /dpal ldan zung 'jug rdo rje don dam/ sems dpa' kun rdzob/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyis ni bshad rgyud bzhis so/ /shin tu ni mi shes pa dang bral te ma nor bar ro/ /gsal ba ni the tshom dang bral te sgra zur ma chag pa'o/ /rnam phye ni log rtog dang bral te rgyud kyi don tshig re re nas so/ /legs bshad pa ni tshig rang yang legs par ro/

/'chad lugs kyi chings sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ma yin pa dang / dgongs/ dgongs min/ drang don/ nges don te/ tshig dang / don dang / tshig don gnyis ka'i mtha' drug gi chings kyis bcings nas so/ /de lta bu'i bshad tshul dka' zhing zab pa ni rgyal sras te/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi yul du gyur pa de la bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa thugs kyi nying khu bskyed rdzogs gnyis so/ /rgyas btab ni mtshan pa'i rgya'o/ /zhes pa'i don bka' mchan las byung bas mdor na dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal nas rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa zla ba grags pa bdag gis bshad pa'i rgyud bzhis mtha' drug gi chings dang ldan par klu sgrub kyi gdam ngag la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs don rim gnyis kyi rgya dang ldan pa de/ slob ma dang rgyud 'dzin rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyi don du bshad ces pa'o/ /gsungs te/ de lta bu'i mtshon no/ /gleng gzhi'i bshad pa'i skabs su rim lnga'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang ste yun ring po song / de man chad la sngon la rgyud kyi steng du 'bru snon dang bshad pa go sla ba re/ de nas 'grel pa'i 'bru gnon rgya che ba re/ de nas bu ṭīka ltar 'bru dang bshad pa sbyar ba re/ de nas ṭīk+ka 'dir de bzhin bshad kyang / mchan chen dang / rdog dang / rlan gyis go bde la don bzang ba 'di ltar mdzad gsungs pa dang / skabs mang por ni mchan chen gyi yin tshod du 'dug ste/ mngon shes can gzhung 'di la 'di ltar 'chad/ btsun mo can 'di 'dra byed/ nag po pas 'di skad gsungs te/ khong kun gyi bshad lugs ya mtshan che ba/ rje 'gos kyang gsung sgros 'di tsam yang so sor ma 'dres par bkod pa thugs bsam dge ba bstan pa la bsam pa a tsi ba a tsi ba/ 'di lta bu sngon gyi sa skya pa rnying pa tsho la kyai rdor bir+wa pa'i lugs la gzhan mi bsre/

man ngag lugs dang 'grel pa lugs mi bsre/ mang ngag lugs kyi yang thun mong du gsungs pa dang / lam 'bras kyi lung sbyor mi bsre ba yod/ ding sang yin na rgyal khams gyi lung 'khyams kun yo bsre tshar bslad tshar/ rje 'gos kyis 'di bzhin mdzad pa sku drin che gsung / dus phyis kyi gsang 'dus yang gsar pa rnams ni sgron gsal mchan dang mtha' dpyad zer ba'i rigs lam nas drangs zer/ spyir bla med kyi grub mtha' dang mi mthun/ sgos su mar 'gos sogs la ye med pa'i/ sol ba brdar bas dkar po mi 'byung ba ltar/ rang lus 'dis sangs rgyas mi 'grub/ rnam smin gyi lus dor te rang bzhin gnyug ma'i yid lus gcig gis zung 'jug bsgrub thabs bya ba sogs gsung rab la dbang chen po mang po byas yod de/ bla med kyi rgyud rgya gzhung gi go ba rnal ma re chags na yi ge de kun brlags pa tsam gyis rang skyon rjen cher te rig rgyu gcig yong bya ba sogs dgag sgrub kyang mang du mdzad pas chos thun shin tu che/ rjes na mar la mkhas mchog don yod dpal ba'i drung nas/ chos grol nas rang gi gnas su phebs nas 'di skad gsungs te/ gsang sngags pa'i chos kyi 'chad lugs bu ṭīka yig tshogs can de phyag tu bsnams/ de'i yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa la 'bru bsnan/ der rting des go chod mod/ yang de bkag nas snga rabs pa'i bzhed pa ste/ yang na snga rabs pa la thugs rtsis mdzad rting bu ṭīka gi gang mdzad bshad lugs de rno la bzang po/ nyung ba 'dug pa de ka gnang bas chog mod/ phyogs snga la yang kha cig ste zhes mi chen gyi tshig sbrams po mdzad pas chog pa la/ chos rje dge ldan chen pos 'di ru 'di skad bris/ 'di'i dus 'di skad gsungs/ de 'dras ga na 'ong / a pha pha zhes gsungs pa sogs de 'dra gsung ga la dgos/ bla ma chen po 'di tsam du song nas mi chos gru bzhi lam pa byas pas chog pa yin gsungs te/

drung nas rang spyir dga' ba gdong la 'byon dgos pas rgyud myur bar grol na dgongs pa dang / khyad par mtshan nyid kyi chos mang po 'chad dgos pas chos thun chung tsam la chos 'gro che ba byung na dgos par 'dug go /bdag gi bsam mno la ni/ sngon la rgyud rkyang la 'bru bsnan te/ ting nge 'dzin 'dis nyams len 'di ston gsungs pa des brda chad lam pa re chags/ de nas sgrol gsal la 'bru bsnan te tshul bzhi sogs bshad tshul 'grel pa rang skad gsal sing nge 'ong / bu ṭīka phyag tu bsnams nas 'chad cing tshig re re bzhin 'bru bsnan te gsungs pa ni chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa de bu ston la shin tu mos pas/ bu ston bka' 'bum bzhengs/ cung zad ma grub pa la chos rje nyid la gsob gnang ste gsab kyang yod/ rjes kyang bu ṭīka steng nas tshar gsum gsan pa de'i 'brel dang zhen par gda'/ rjes su yig cha rnying pa rnams kyi lugs de man ngag thon che ba dang go sla ba sogs dgos pa mang po gzigs pa yin te/ de tsho'i gsung skyor tsa na/ khong kun gsang 'dus la mi tshe phyi zhing dril ba rnams zhes gsungs pa sogs che brjod mdzad pa/ yig cha bzang po de rnams kyi bshad sgrub dar la re bar 'dug bu ston gzigs rgya che yang / rdog dang / rlan gyi yig cha rnams las 'gos kyi stong thun dang / mchan chen/ shog dril gsum dang ma mjal tshod du 'dug te/ khong pa nan tar bshad yams mang pa la rdog pas 'di ltar gsung zhes pa las/ 'gos gyi yig cha na 'di yod ces ma bkod do/ /'dus pa ba phyi ma rnams la dgag sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe yang rje'i zhal la blta snying 'dod cing da dung sun 'byin dang tshig nyams 'dra byung na bsam dga' ru tshor ba dang / chos thun 'di da rung ma grol na snyam pa dang ba dang / 'di lta bu'i rgyud sde khyad par can rje 'gos lta bu'i lo tsā ba rang bzo mi mdzad pa la man ngag che ba'i gsung la gtug tu yod pa/

bdag rang yang bsod nams che ba snyam pa byung zhing / zha lu pa'i drin las kyang gsang 'dus kyi bshad srol bzang po da lta'i bar du byung bar 'dug snyam pa dang / dge ldan pas kyang gsang 'dus la go la ma go'i yig cha mdzad/ ding sang dar bas rjes kyang dge ldan du sku mdun du yang khong tsho'i lugs dpyis phyin par zhus/ yig cha rnams kyang bzhengs/ bshad pa mdzad pas khong tshos rigs lam nas 'dren zhes smras pa de'i gnyen por rjes snga rabs pa'i lung man ngag thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mang po'i mdzod brtol te/ lhug par gnang ba 'di khong tshos 'ben bzang po btsugs pa'i drin kyang yin par go bas kho bo la ni dge ldan pa la dgra'i 'du shes rnam pa thams cad du med do/ /de ltar zla ba gsum gyi bar du snga chos/ dgong chos gnyis ka la 'dus pa la gril te/ rgyud 'grel/ bshad srol gsar rnying phyogs snga'i tshul gyis dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i gnad dang / spyi bshad kyi dus 'chad do/ /gsungs pa'i gzhung phran rnams dang / grub chen klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa dang bcas pa thams cad gnang zhing / rgyun ma chad par nyan pa lags so/ /bdag gis de gong dang de'i rjes nas kyang bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa dang khrid thos pa'i tshe/ 'gos lugs gtso che ba la mar pa'i bsdus gsal dang / gdan rdzogs/ nag khrid/ dmar khrid sogs na dmigs pa'i rkang 'di lta bu yod do/ /zhes khrid kyi don rnams legs par thob cing / lung rnams ni da thob la re yod do/ /zhes pa de rnams ni chos rje srad pa kun blo'i gsang 'dus rgyud bshad zin bris nas 'byung tshul rnams bshad pa ste/ de ltar bris pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon gyi skyes chen rnams kyis gsang 'dus kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad pa la/ dang 'dod kyi dad pa dbang med du bskyed pa'i phyir dang / rjes 'jug 'chad nyan byed pa la yang lag len gyi rnam dbye shes pa'i phyir gsung rgyun zin bris kyis tshig zur tsam yang ma 'chugs pa bkod pa yin te/
