/zhes pas bstan/ rgyud zab pa'i che ba bstan pa ni/ tsan+dan lta bu la sogs pa'i gang zag rnams kyi som nyi dang bral ba de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsan+dan lta bu la sogs pa mtha' drug ma shes pa de dag gis rdo rje 'chang gi rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshig 'di thos nas sems ma rangs pas so/ /rab tu ngus so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rin chen lta bu dbang po rno rtul gyi phyogs gnyis ka la 'jigs pa med pa de dag thams cad kyis sdug bsngal ba'i yid kyi dbang po dman pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' tsan+dan lta bu mi dga' ba de rnams la dbugs 'byin pa'i tshig 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sa'i snying po la sogs pa tsan+dan lta bu byang chub sems dpa' ste tsan+dan lta bu khyed rnams ma ngu zhig lus ngag yid kyi sdug bsngal gsum la tsan+dan lta bu rgyud kyi don zab mo ni nyams su ma blang ngo / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ni yid byung ba rnams kye ma bdag cag gi tshe 'di la 'bras bu mi thob ma thob na sdug bsngal gsum 'ong ste/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dmyal ba lta bu'am/ 'o skol la na tsha byung ba lta bu nyer len gyi phung lnga sdug bsngal yin pa la de'i steng du mig na ba lta bu ste/ phol mig rang bzhin gyi tsha ba la sman sgyur byed blug pa lta bu 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni da lta phyug cing nor che ba yang gnang zad nas ltogs tsam na kye ma ngas sngar 'di ltar myong ba la da lta med ces sngar gyi bde ba de da lta sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba ste/ phol mig tsha ba la sman bsil byed ga bur blug pa lta bu'o/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa ste phol mig gi rang bzhin tsha ba lta bu ste gsum po de la/

ma sgoms shig de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ces bos nas ji ltar ste yong tshig mi ngu bar bgyi ste ngu tshal/ ji ltar lus ngag yid kyi 'am 'du byed la sogs pa'i yi ge'i don du bshad na sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum ste lha so gnyis te bskyed rim mo spyi'i ni 'bru gsum ste ngag dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /sbas pa ni ye shes gsum po rlung 'byung 'jug las su rung ba'i bzhon pa can no/ /mthar thug bshad na zung 'jug ldang ba'i ye shes gsum ste zung 'jug ldang ba'i rgyu sems kyi mthar thug go /sdug bsngal gsum la mi bsgom par bgyi bsgom 'tshal/ de gnad ka ci'i phyir zhe na zhes dris pa la/ lan du bcom ldan 'das nged gnyis med la rtogs pa gsang ba'i yi ge gsum gyi ming tsam thos pa'i skal ba yang ma mchis na don lta nyams su ci la myong so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsang ba'i yi ge gsum po rnam par dag pa bstan pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa gsang ba'i yig ge rnam par dag cing thob rgyu med ces/ de skad ma zer cig gsang ba'i yi ge gsum gnyis med ye shes ni nged de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang khyed byang chub sems dpa' dang / nged rin po che lta bu dang tsan+dan lta bu yi thun mong ste rigs kyi bu zhes bos nas byang chub sems dpa' tsan+dan lta bu khyed rnams kyis tshul ji ltar sems kyis mi shes pa dang rna ba'i dbang pos ma thos shing bstan du med pa de bzhin du/ nged yang dag par de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gang zag thams cad dang khyed byang chub sems dpa' tsan+dan lta bur thams cad kyis kyang rigs kyi bu gsang ba'i yi ge 'di dag thos par byar med pas na/

bzung bar byar med pas na ma thob cing 'dzin pa po med pas na mngon par rtogs shing khong du chud par byar med pas na sangs ma rgyas so/ /ma thob ma rtogs pa de gnad ka ci'i phyir zhe na zhes 'thad pa dris pa la lan du/ gsang ba'i yi ge sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni rang bzhin gyis/ sgyu ma de 'od gsal gyis rnam par dag cing zung du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan lta bu la sogs pa de dag thams cad cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa thos bsam gyi 'bras bu'i skabs la drug gis/ ston pa 'od gsal la bzhugs pa ni thos bsam gyi 'bras bu ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang spyod pa ma spyad/ rang nyid sangs rgyas nas gzhan don byed pa la bya ste/ rang nyid kyis rtogs pa'i lam las bde pas 'bras bu bde ba thob pa de gdul bya gzhan la bstan pas gzhan yang tshul de nas zhugs pas bde ba chen po thob pa bstan/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku lus dben dang gsung ngag dben dang thugs sems dben rdo rje'i btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ de la lha mo'i dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ gnyis pa lha mo'i glus bskul ba ste/ sku la bsgom pa'i dang spyod pa'i dus gnyis ka ston btsun mo bzhi po bdag po dang bral bas de la dad cing 'dun pa'i yid kyis lta bar 'dod nas smre de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi btsun mo spyan ma bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la 'od gsal du song ba dga' bas bstod pa/ sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa rdo rje 'chang sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum na yod tshad med tshad kyi gnas 'cha' bar 'os shing chos kyi rgyal srid chen po brnyes shing dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug mdun na gnas pa lta bu la smre zhing bos pa ni/

khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ dga' zhing bde ba'i 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i chags pas yid du 'ong zhing tshim pa bskyed pa don chen po mchog tu dga' ba de 'dod cing don du gnyer pas 'khyud pa la sogs pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol cing rol par mdzod cig pa'o/ sems can ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pa'i mgon po ste bdag po gal te de ring bdag ni gson zhing 'tsho par mchis pa gcig tu bzhed cing dgongs na/ dag pa'i sems sems can thams cad bskyed pa'i yab chen ma dag pa'i sems can la phan bde byed pas na sems can gyi gnyen gyi mchog chen pos bdag la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol/ mā ma kis bskul ba ni de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ste mi bskyod pa'i thugs kyi btsun mo 'phags ma mā ma kis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la 'od du zhu nas snang ba med par song ba la rdo rje'i 'dod pa ste pad+mar rdo rje bcug la dga' ba'i mchod pa tha mal pa'i ma yin pa'i shin tu khyad par gyi dga' ba la zhugs pa ste de ston pa'i mchog gi yi ge mi 'gyur ba ngag tu lhung ba 'dis phyin ci ma log cing yang dag par bstod do/ /mi 'jigs pas rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo bshad pa sems can kun la mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde bas phan 'dogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas ni phung po lnga rnams yin la de rnams kyi kun rdzob sgyu ma'i don du byang chub de'i don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /sems can de rnams ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pa'i mgon po brgya la gal te dus de ring lha mo mā ma ki bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dang srog gi gson zhing 'tsho par mchi sa par bzhed na/

/lus dang longs spyod la chags pa'i 'dod chags de sems can thams cad kyis mi 'da' bas na dam tshig chags pas bdag lha mo mā ma ki la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la/ 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug gi 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i spyan gyis te gos dkar mos rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la 'od gsal du zhu ba 'dod pa la nye bar longs spyod pa'i dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba'i dam tshig gis yang dag par bstod pa/ khyod ni rdo rje gsung ste ngag gi dbang phyug brnyes pa/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba mchog tu thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can no/ /de nyid kyis na tshad med pa bzhi bde ba dang phrad pa dang sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang de gnyis la dga' ba dang chags sdang med pa'i rnam pas 'jig rten dag gi ngan song na gnas pa rnams mtho ris su 'dren/ mtho ris pa rnams thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas su bkod pa'i dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la dus thams cad du rtag tu brtson pas spyod pa/ /gdul bya rnams ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pa'i mgon po brgya la na gal te dus de ring bdag ni gson zhing srog 'tsho par 'jig rten na mchis par bzhed na/ /zag pa med pa'i rab tu dga'i spyod pa sems can gyi khams dang kun tu bzang zhing dge ba thob par mdzad pa po zhes bos nas bdag la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi don la mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig ste 'phrin las kyis rdo rje'i don yod grub pa btsun mo sgrol mas/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin chen po rang bzhin phyag rgya drug cu'i rgyu ba 'gags shing ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyis thams cad stong par bzhugs pa la blta zhing 'od gsal du zhu ba la sa slong ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zag med kyi lus kyi tshor ba bde ba ste dga' ba dang / /yid dga' ba 'og nas 'byung ba 'dis bstod do/ /khyod ni 'phrin las kyi rdo rje'i pad+ma sbyor ba las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis zhe sdang la sogs pa'i sems can gyi khams rnam par sbyong ba 'dod pa ste mi 'da' bar nam las kyi rigs dam tshig ste don grub mchog gi 'dod chags la spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i thabs kyi byang chub rab tu brtsams pas na phan don che/ /shākya'i rigs las byung ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pas na'am yang na bya grub so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don mdzad pas na yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog bdag dang gzhan du rnam par dbye ba'i dmigs pa dang bral yang sems can rnams la nye ring med par mnyam pa nyid du thugs rjes gzigs pa/ /sems can ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pa'i mgon po gal te bdag ni brgya la dus de rang sgrol ma gson zhing 'tsho par mchis bzhed cing dgongs na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes shing rol pa dga' ba gsum gyi rim gyis rnam par dag pa'i gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye par mdzod/ /ces pas bstan/ dpal shin tu dga' ba'i bde bas 'dod chags la spyod pa bstan pa ni/ gsum pa 'dod pa la longs spyod pa ni de nas rgyu spyod pa bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/

'dod chags te gzugs la sogs pa'i yul thams cad lha dang sems tsam dang stong pa nyid du de dang des de la rol cing nye bar longs spyod pa'i rdo rje dpal te kun dga' ba'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bying rgod med par snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bzhi po thams cad kyi btsun mo de spyan ma la sogs pa de dag la bde stong las mi 'da' zhing bskyed pa'i lam tshig gi rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i 'khor lo dri sngon du song ba'i me tog la sogs pas mchod pa'i rjes la gsang ba'i mchod pa nang reg bya'i mchod pa 'khyud pa dang 'o byed pa dang 'jib pa dang thal mos brdab pa dang / so dang sen mos 'debs pa dang nu ma mnye ba dang zhud steng dang / rab tu bskyangs pa dang grong gi bya ba dang / de ji ltar na mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang / gdub bu dang / 'khor gdub dang rkang gdub kyi sgra dang yul dang dbang po rdo rje pad mo mnyam par sbyor zhing / shes rab dang thabs snyoms par zhugs pas/ a li dang ka li dang / 'dod pa'i gdugs dang / rus sbal dang zla ba gang ba ste rtsa sbubs gsum sor mo gsum gyis bskyod cing rab tu bskul ba'i dga' ba'i sgyu ma'i sgras mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bas phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi ngo bo nyid spyi bo nas brtsam ste dri ma med pa'i chu'i rgyun bzhin du bzhus la/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bor 'dzag pas/ chos 'byung ba'i nang du yang dag par bzhag ste/ des 'dod chags la spyod pa'i sems can rnams rnam par sbyangs ba'i phyir/ 'khor los 'dod pa spyod cing cang mi gsung zhing bde ba myong bar gyur to/ /bzhi pa des dbang bskur bas sems can thams cad kyi bde ba thob pa/ dbang bskur bas sems can thams cad bde ba thob pa ni de nas te ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes la nam mkha'i dbyings 'di dag thams cad na sems can yod tshad smin cing grol bar byas pa'i rim gyis phyag rgya chen po thob pa de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rnam par snang mdzad dang gsung snang ba mtha' yas dang mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje'i zhu ba/

mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig gi khu bas pad+ma'i nang gang bas lha bskyed pa'am thig les yongs su gang bas dbang bskur ste/ dper na bum pa rdo rje chus gang ba ltar tshogs rdzogs pa'am snying rje'i chus gang bar gnas shing mi g.yo par gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas dbang bskur ba'i sems can rnams bde ba thob par bstan pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snyoms 'jug gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ni/ de nas yang rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings 'di na gang skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can sku gsum gyi dam tshig rdo rje gsum las yang dag par byung ba de rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid rnams rdo rje dpal te rdo rje 'chang chen pos bstan pa'i chos kyi 'am khu ba'i thig les reg nas/ thams cad dbang bskur byas chos de la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i ye shes can du gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje 'od kyi dbang bskur gyi brtsams te sems can thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur bar gyur nas kun tu bzang po kun tu bzang po zhes sngon ma byung ba'i don gyi ming can du gyur nas sangs rgyas so zhes pa'i don do/ /rgyu des na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje bskur bar gyur pas na de ltar gyur to/ /lnga pa 'dod pa la longs spyod pas bde ba thob pa la ngo mtshar ba ni gdul bya'i sems can thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas na sems can mnyam pa nyid du bstan pas ji ltar rtogs pa brjod pa ni de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/

/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad ces bos nas bde ba chen po kyi chos kyi ye shes su'o/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs pa sems can la skyes pa mthong ngam/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa thams cad kyis gnyis med ye shes dang ldan pa'i rtags su phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'am gtso bo bya ba byed pa la 'og nas 'byung ba 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang gis snyom par 'jug pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba nyid kyis sems can thams cad snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba bdag gir mdzad cing zil gyis mnan nas bde ba chen po thob pa'i rdo rje stong pa nyid ye shes bde chen kyi spyod pa mthong lags so/ /zag med kyi bde ba chen por gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /de nas de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes kyi spyod pa nyams su myong bar mdzad nas yang snyoms par 'jug pa las bzhengs te thugs rab tu dgyes par gyur pa ji ltar bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos nyid 'od gsal ba btsun mo'i bha ga las nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon par phyung nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rtags su phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po la 'og nas 'byung ba 'di skad ces snyan du gsol to/ /rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi 'dod chags kyi yi ge'i ste mi 'gyur ba tshig gi ste pa tā gnas te spyod pas sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje 'chang gi byang chub bde stong zung 'jug pa'i ye shes rjes su rtogs shing thob pa de ni bcom ldan 'das rang don du rtogs pa ngo mtshar ro/

/bde bar gshegs pa gzhan don du rtogs pa ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'dod chags rnam par dag par bstan pas the tshom dang bral ba ni/ de nas drug pa 'dod chags rnam par dag pa ste stong pa nyid du bsgom pa bstan pa la the tshom dang bral ba ni 'o na 'dod chags de yang tha mal pa'i dngos por zhen pa'i nyon mongs pa can gyis byang chub thob bam snyam pa la mi thob bo gnyen po'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa yin zhes pa ni phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje 'chang chen po 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ces bos nas nyon mongs pa dang dga' bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes thob bam zhes the tshom gyi tshig mi zer ba de skad ma zer cig de gnad ka ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni chos nyid 'od gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu'i rdo rje 'chang drug pa'i dang mtshungs shing 'dra pa'i/ gzugs kyi dngos por mngon par zhen pa can gyi phung po gzugs can la sogs pa grub pa ma yin/ nyams su myong ba'i tshor ba'i phung po ra zhen pa ma yin/ byed pa med pa rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa khams su zhen pa ma yin/ rnam par shes pa skye zhing mched par byed pa dang po dang yul du ma yin/ de bzhin du 'dir lus dang longs spyod la zhen pa'i 'dod chags bde bas bde ba thob pa'i skabs rang dga' mas bde ba chen po zung 'jug thob pa ma yin/ sems can dang sems can ma yin pa la zhe sdang rang ka mas ma yin/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i gti mug rang dga' mas bde ba chen po thob pa ma yin/ dkar po'i chos su zhen pa ma yin pa rang zhen pas thob pa ma yin no/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pas de dag thams cad 'dod chags la sogs pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal gnyis su med pa nyid du gsungs pa'i tshig gi rjes thogs la mngon du byas nas brjod du med pa'i chos nyid de nyid las bsgom zhing cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rgyud gtad pa la bzhi las/ skal ba dang ldan pa la spyir gtad pa ni/ de nas rgyud gtad pa la bzhi las bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rje ste rdo rje 'chang chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa de rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad 'dus pa'i rdo rje 'di bsgom zhing bsgrags par gyis shig bsgrag pa de gang bsgrag na rdo rje 'dzin chen po thob par byed pa mi 'da' bar bsten pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang de ston pa'i gzhung gi tshogs la le'u bcu bdun pa 'di sgrogs shig ci ste na dus deng sang gi sems can rnams ni 'dod chags kyis byang chub thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i snod du gyur pa yin pas shes pa ni/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhes dris pa la snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus kyi phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags can de rnams chos kyi rnam grangs gsang ba 'dus 'di la nyams su len cing 'bras bu thob pa'i skal pa yod pa'i phyir ro des ni yul lnga la chags pa'i sems can rgyud 'di'i snod du bstan pa'i/ /zhes pas bstan/ rdo rje chos la khyad par bstan pa ni gnyis pa rdo rje chos la khyad par du gtad pa ni/

da ni ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la bstan pa'i phyir rdo rje chos la khyad par du gtad pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje chos te chos 'dzin pas na phyag na rdo rje bsdud pa po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu zhes bos nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa'i thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa las 'ongs ba'i/ dam tshig sa mā ya mi 'da' bar bsten pa'i/ mi bslu bas na de kho na nyid bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang spyod pa brjod par ston pa'i gsang 'dus 'di yid la zungs shig la zhog cig phyag na rdo rje bsdud pa po khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa thams cad kyi chos 'dzin cing bsdud pa la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi gzhung du byas pa'i chos rnams la spobs pa dpag tu med pas na dbang phyug ste gtso bo/ dbang phyug ces de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs cing / dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos kyis phyag na rdo rje de bzhin du bdag gi rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa gzhung dang don du bcas pa'i bzung bar bgyi'o/ /gsung ji lta ba bzhin du blang ngo zhes gsol nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas sems can thams cad sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag po thob par bstan pa ni/ de nas rgyud gtad pa'i rjes la brjod du med pa'i yang sangs rgyas kyis zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i gdul bya sems can de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can rnams kyi ci zhig thob par mdzad ce na sngon dus su rigs lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa rjes 'jug tu zlos pa po so gnyis po thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i a k+ṣa ra mi 'gyur ba'i yi ge gsum la de bzhin gshegs pa rang gi sku 'ja' tshon lta bu dang gsung sgra snyan lta bu dang thugs nam mkha' lta bu zhugs shing 'dus par gyur te rnam snang dang 'od dpag med dang mi bskyod pa dang gsum thob bam yang na de gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lha thams cad mi bskyod par 'dus/

to/ /zhes pas bstan/ rdo rje gsum po khams gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bor bstan pa ni/ de nas khams gsum thams cad kyi lus rnam snang gi rang bzhin yin bya ba'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad 'dod pa la sogs pa khams gsum pa ste srid pa thams cad po skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can rab 'bring gsum mo/ /kyi lus dbang po gzugs can rten dang bcas pa dang mi phyed pa'i rdo rje chos nyid stong pa nyid la gnas shing lus dang rnam par snang mdzad ni rten dang brten pa nyid du med cing sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi lus kyang rang bzhin stong par dbyer med pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i snang ba mnyam pa nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i bden pa gnyis dbyer med pas na sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs nas sangs rgyas dang sems can kyi lus don dam par chos nyid stong par mnyam kun rdzob snang ba tsam du mnyam pas de gnyis snang stong dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug gcig ang snyam du/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas khams gsum po thams cad kyi ngag gang yin pa ni 'od dpag med yin bya ba'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsung rdo rje khams gsum kyi skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i thams cad kyi ngag brjod pa thams cad chos nyid stong pa'i rdo rje la blo gnas shing / de dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yang sgra snyan lta bu/ grag pa tsam ma 'gags sgra'i rdul phra rab rdzas su grub pa med pa'i chos nyid stong pa nyid dang mnyam pa nyid dbyer med pa'i rtogs pa la gnas nas 'o na sems can rnams kyi ngag brjod pa sgra'i rnam pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu gdul bya la chos bshad pa'i sgrar snang du byung ba thams cad kyang don dam par rang bzhin gyis stong pa yin la kun rdzob tsam du grag pa'i rnam pa ma 'gags pas grag stong dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug yin yang snyam du cang mi gsung zhing zhal rog sdod bar gyur to gsung rgyu med pas so/

/de nas de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi sems mi bskyod pa yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa phyag na rdo rje/ 'dod pa la sogs pa'i khams te srid pa gsum mam sa 'og sa steng sa bla thams cad rtog bcas dang rtog med kyi sems snang ba gsum dang rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rig pa myong gsal gyi chos nyid stong pa'i rdo rje rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba la blo gnas shing / /de dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sems zag pa med pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyang don dam par rang bzhin gyi stong pa 'od gsal ba yin la kun rdzob la btags pa'i ngo bo tsam du snang bas rigs stong gnyis su med pa'i mnyam zhing ro gcig pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to 'ga' zhig rgyud nye bar bsdu ba ni/ de yan chad du rgya gar skad nas bzung nas gyur to yan chad du'o/ /snang ba tsam nyid nas dngos por ma grub pas stong ngo de'i phyir na sems can kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs tha mi dad de gcig gi rang bzhin yin des na smra rgyu ci yang med do/ /ji skad bka' stsal na rgyud la 'jug par byed pa'i rten gang zag gnyis sam lngas sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i shes pa'i snang ba las dang nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog gi 'bras bu 'di bzhi bsgyur zhing spang bya rang gi sems rgyud la nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi sa bon rgyu spong ba'i ched du/ dmigs yul 'bras bu mthar thug pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang la dmigs nas lam smin lam gyis rgyud smin cing sgrub pa'i snod du rung bar byas/ grol lam gyi rtogs pa rnam pa gsum las grol bar byas nas zung 'jug mi slob pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'di la thob pa'i thabs/

rtsa rgyud du de skad ces bka' stsal pa rgyud phyi mar de nyid cung zad gsal bar bshad/ bshad rgyud bzhis shin tu gsal bar bshad pa yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal to mdor na sems can thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yin la ngag ni snang ba mtha' yas yin sems ni mi bskyod pa yin no/ /'o na de ltar bstan pa ci ste na lus so sor gzhigs/ /zhes pas bstan/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rgyud don gang gis gsal bar byed pa ni/ slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas kyi bka' drin gyis rgyu don dang / tshul dang / chos nyid la som nyi dang bral mod/ som nyi gzhan 'ga' zhig mchis te/ mtha' drug gi bshad pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i sngags pa rnams/ sgra ji bzhin du gsungs pa'i tshig la brten nas/ rang rang gi slob dpon gyi man ngag gis/ zla ba dang rdo rje la sogs pa mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga'i rim pas/ srid pa skye ba'i rim pa ltar/ yongs su brtags pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor tsam la slob kyang / yongs su dag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rtog pa thams cad las 'das pa/ so so rang gi rig pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul phung po rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang na gnas pa/ yod pa dang med pa'i phyogs dang bral ba/ yi ge'i rjes su 'brangs pa rnams dang / tog ge pa rnams kyi yul ma yin pa/ bla ma'i man ngag 'ba' zhig las shes par bya ba/ 'di lta bu'i lha'i de kho na nyid shes par mi nus pas/ yongs su dag pa'i lha'i de kho na nyid 'di lta bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das shing / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i bsdu pa po rnams kyang med par gyur pa phyi ma'i dus na/ sangs rgyas kyi yang dag par 'gro ba 'di/ rgyun mi 'chad par su zhig ston par 'gyur/ gdul bya sems can rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur zhes zhus pa'o/ /de'i lan slob dpon gyis smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang /

ji srid 'jig rten du dam pa'i chos gnas pa de srid kyi bar du/ rdo rje theg pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud mtha' drug tshul bzhis bcings kyang / de'i dgongs pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba la sogs pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud kyis bkral ba la brten nas/ bskyed pa'i go rim gyis/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs te/ tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba'i man ngag slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas brtsams te/ gter gyi kha byang dang 'dra bar/ slob dpon rnams brgyud pa rim gyis/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing 'pho'o/ /slob dpon klu sgrub nyid rgyud kyi don la 'khrul ba med par ci shes snyam na/ de la gnyis te/ bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan pa dang / rang nyid kyis ye shes brnyes par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ rtog ge rnams kyi yul min pas/ /so so rang rig ye shes ni/ /phyi ma'i dus su gyur pas na/ /mgon po su zhig 'dzin gyur gsungs/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /dus dag 'das nas 'byung ba ni/ /gang zhig bstan pa 'dzin gyur te/ /blo gros chen po khyod shes byos/ /lho phyogs be da'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan zhes bya ba/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten 'dir/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rang nyid kyis ye shes brnyes par bstan pa ni/ slob dpon chen po dpal klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyis/ nyid kyis don rjes su brnyes nas/ so so rang rig pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten du bstan nas/ lha dang mi'i bde ba las 'das shing / mu stegs dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam gtan dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba las 'das nas/

skye ba dang / 'gag pa dang bral ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ lta bas chog mi shes pa stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa brnyes nas/ bde ba can du gshegs pa ste/ yon tan gyi dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /de'i phyir slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas brgyud pa'i man ngag ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa la 'khrul pa med par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa gzhung nye bar bsdu ba ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa la sogs pa/ rgyud ma lus par rgyan rnam pa bdun dang / bshad pa'i tshul rnams kyis thos nas/ don dang tshul dang / chos nyid khong du chud de rim pa gnyis kyi man ngag sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ nyan pa po rnams la yang dag par bshad pas/ brtsams pa'i don dang / bdag nyid kyis dam bcas pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par ston pa ni/ sdud par byed pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes smras te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di gong du ji skad bstan pa de skad ces/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos bka' stsal zhing bstan to/ /zhes pa'o/ /le'u'i ming ni le'u'i mtshan don ni/ de gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku 'i rigs 'ja' tshon lta bu lus dben sgyu ma dang gsung gi rigs sgra snyan lta bu dang thugs kyi rigs nam mkha' lta bu sems dben zung 'jug kyi gsang ba sum cu rtsa gnyis gsang ba rdo rje 'chang du 'dus pa 'i bskyed rim bsgom pa las zung 'jug mi slob pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa la lus 'dus/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa thams cad kyi bka' srung gi dam tshig dang sdom pa nan tan du bya ba rigs lnga'i dbye ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'da' bar mi bya zhing phyed par bya ba yin pas na/ rdo rje'i byin gyis rlabs kyi rgyal po rigs thams cad kyi bdag po thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa chen po'i skyes bu'i gzugs zhes bya ba'i le'u ste grangs bcu bdun pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las de las bshad du med pa'o ye shes kyi sku rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid can sku gsum dang theg pa gsum dang dus gsum dang rdo rje gsum dang bden pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can zhes drug pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'o/

de ston pa'i gzhung bsdus pa'i le'u ste gong dang 'dra bas na'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas rgyud kyi mtshan smos pa'i rdzogs tshul bstan pa ni rtsa rgyud kyi mtshan ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la gsang zhing rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad la rab tu gsang ba 'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa zhes bya ba ste ming de skad ces bya'o/ /de nyid mchog tu gyur pas na rtog pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mi rtog pa'i ye shes las sems can gyi don du gang la gang mos su yongs su brtags pas na rtog pa'o/ /chen po'i rgyal po dang 'dra bas na rgyal po rdzogs so/ /zhes pas bstan sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po rje 'gos lha btsas kyis mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa chen mo nas gal che ba phal che ba zhig 'dir yang mchan bur btab pa yin no// ༈ //de ni zhar las 'ongs pa rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa'i don 'grel khog phub kyang shes par bya ste/ de la yang / le'u'i don dang / le'u'i ming gnyis las/ dang po le'u'i don ni/ de yang thog mar 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bstan pa la/ dngos po thams cad ji lta ba dang / dus ji lta ba bzhin du mthong zhing thos te rtogs nas/ chos mthong ba dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma'o kun tu bzang po yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nges pa dag /rdo rje gsung la kun tu ni/ /rdo rje gsum la kun tu bzhugs/ /sems can thams cad dus gsum gyi/ /rdo rje ngo bor yang dag byung /

/sangs rgyas rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob po/ /e ma ho 'di rab ngo mtshar che/ /e ma ho zhi ba dbang po 'das/ /e ma ho 'khor ba dag gi rgyun/ /e ma ho mchog tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bka' stsal pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams de de bzhin te/ sems dpa' chen po de de bzhin no/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams yang 'dus par gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad la gsang ba bla na med pa dang / phyi'i mchod pas yang dag par mchod de/ phyag 'tshal nas/ mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho shin tu thob dka' ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yin/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya'i rgyud/ /rgyud kyi mchog gi mchog gyur pa/ /rtogs dka' de nyid rtogs phyir dang / /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /yang dag gsung bas gang bshad pa/ /mgon po khyed la gsol bar 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bka' stsal pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gang zhig sbas pa'i rgyud tshig de/ /de dag thams cad zhu 'dod pa'i/ /legs so legs so sems dpa' che/ /yon tan 'byung gnas legs so legs/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems kun gyis/ /rab tu dga' ba'i spyan rgyas pas/ /yang nas yang du phyag 'tshal nas/

/the tshom thams cad zhus pa ste/ /gsang ba zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /'dus pa zhes ni gang la brjod/ /rgyud kyi 'grel ba ji lta bu/ /rnal 'byor rgyud 'di ci la bgyi/ /de nyid rnam pa du ru gsungs/ /de bzhin gsang ba rnam pa du/ /gsang chen zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /dam pa rnam pa du zhig mchis/ /byang chub sems zhes gang la bgyi/ /de bzhin rigs pa'i skyes bu ci/ /badz+ra dh+rig ces ji ltar legs/ /de bzhin dzi na dzig ni gang / /rad na dh+rig ni ji ltar lags/ /a ro lig ni ci la bgyi/ /pra nya dh+rig ces gang la bgyi/ /rigs 'dir de bzhin gang yin lags/ /mo ha zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /dhe sha zhes kyang 'dir gang lags/ /ra ga zhes ni ci la bgyi/ /badz+ra sngags ni gang la bgyi/ /ra ti zhes 'di gang la bgyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa gang zhig lags/ /ya ma ta trid don ni gang / /de bzhin prad nya ta trid ci/ /pad ma ta trid ming ji ltar/ /de bzhin bhig nan ta trid ci/ /mgon po spyod pa gang zhig lags/ /de bzhin sngags kyi spyod pa gang / /'dir ni bzlas brjod gang zhig lags/ /rgyas 'debs pa zhes gang la bshad/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas ji ltar bsgom/ /de bzhin sdom pa ji ltar lags/ /zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags ches/ /sems can don mdzad ji lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /phyag rgya dgod pa'ang ji ltar lags/ /'dir ni me tog ci zhig lags/ /mchod rten zhes ni gang la bshad/ /ye shes 'khor lo ji ltar 'tshal/ /'dir ni gnas zhes gang la bshad/ /mgon po bskul ba ji lta bu/ /gtong ba dag kyang ji lta bu/ /ji ltar de rnams spyan drang bgyi/ /bcing ba 'dir ni ji lta bu/ /dbang bskur ba ni ji ltar 'tshal/ /de bzhin rig pa'i brtul zhugs gang / /bdud rtsi rnam lnga ji ltar bza'/ /de bzhin dpa' bo lnga gang lags/ /dngos grub tha mal ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin mchog ni ji lta bu/ /de la thabs ni rnam pa du/

/de bzhin thabs bcu ji lta bu/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor can kun gyis/ /las kyi mchog gi tshogs rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs ji ltar byed par 'gyur/ /bka' ni ji ltar bsgo bar bgyi/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dri ba de dag gi lan/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsung bar thugs kyis dgongs pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis zhus pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dzin la dmigs par mdzad nas skad cig cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ slar yang 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang yang du gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid rab dga' nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs/ /mgon la yang dang yang rab bskul/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nyan par gdams pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje la/ /bzhag nas byang chub sems dpa' bo/ /zhus pa rgya chen mnyan par gyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la legs so gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis rjes su bzung ba'i bka' spyi bor rab tu mnos te/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so bde bar gshegs pa legs so legs so zhes gsol nas/ rang gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rdo rjes/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i sku dang / gsung dang thugs rdo rje la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sngar gyi dri ba rnams kyi lan bka' stsal pa ni/

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rang rang gi thugs/ thugs rdo rje chen po la dmigs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la zhus pa de dag gsung gcig gis bka' stsal pa/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /'tshogs pa 'dus par yin par bshad/ /lnga pa dang ni dgu pa dang / /bcu bdun pa dang bcu gsum pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyi/ /bstan pa dag ni sgrub byed yin/ /bzhi pa dang ni bcu drug pa/ /brgyad dang dpe bzhin bcu gnyis pa/ /slob dpon sbyin pa'i las dang ni/ /dngos grub brtul zhugs sdom pa yin/ /drug pa dang ni gnyis pa dang / /bcu pa dang ni bcu bzhi pa/ /grag spyod rjes su chags pa dang / /nye bar sgrub pa'i sdom pa 'o/ /bdun pa dang ni gsum pa dang / /bcu gcig pa dang bco lnga pa/ /dngos grub zhing dang mtshan ma ni/ /bsnyen pa bsgrub pa'i sdom pa 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi las/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs spyod pa dag /dul dang 'dul dka' zhi ba yi/ /sems can rnams ni 'jug pa 'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim dang 'brel ba yis/ /bsnyen pa'i rdo rje cho ga bzhi/ /thun mong dngos grub 'grel pa yin/ /mchog tu gyur pa gzhung nyid do/ /dkyil 'khor brtul zhugs 'brel ba yi/ /gzhung ni slob dpon phun tshogs pa'o/ /bla mas sngags kyi lam gyis ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin bya ba/ /brtul zhugs bzang dang dbang bskur dang / /rang gi slob ma bdag nyid che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyi/ /ston pas yongs su grol ba yin/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /gang zhig dngos med shes rab ste/ /thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya bar grags/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum gyur te/ /gzhi dang de bzhin rang bzhin dang /

/mi 'phrogs pa yi rab dbye bas/ /gzhi dang rang bzhin rgyu yin te/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu 'o/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya ba ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /rigs ni lnga dang gsum dag kyang / /ngo bo nyid gcig rigs brgya 'o/ /byang chub rdo rje bcas gsungs pa/ /de ni phyi ma'i rgyud du 'dod/ /de nyid rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /gsang ba rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gsang chen te/ /dam pa'i rigs ni rnam pa brgya/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med mi zad gtso/ /stong nyid snying rje mi phyed pa/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /mi phyed dbye ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /rigs dang lhan cig ldan pas na/ /rig pa'i skyes bu zhes brjod do/ /rgyu lnga dang ni 'bras bu lnga/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /'chang ba 'dzin ces grags pa ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnam shes yid/ /yod dang med dang dbus las 'das/ /'byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur las 'byung / /sems can kun gyi lus yin te/ /skyes las rgyal ba dzi na dzig /don rnams thams cad 'byung bas na/ /sems ni rin po che zhes bya/ /tshor ba po yis nges tshor bas/ /tshor ba rad na dh+rig du 'dod/ /mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi dngos po yi/ /kun la kun gyis thams cad du/ /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi ni/ /a ro lig ces bshad pa yin/ /rnam shes rab mthar phyin byed pa/ /gang yin de ni shes rab ste/ /'du byed sems la 'dzin pas na/ /shes rab 'dzin zhes bya bar bshad/ /rigs ni rgyud ces bya bar bshad/ /rgyud ni thog ma zhes brjod de/ /mi 'jig skye ba med gang yin/ /mgon po de ni yin par bshad/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis la sdang bas na/ /rnam shes zhe sdang yin par bshad/ /bem po bcings pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /gzugs ni gti mug ces byar bshad/ /bdag tu rlom pa'i ngo bo bas/ /tshor ba dregs pa yin par bshad/

/dngos la chags pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /'du shes yang dag chags bdag nyid/ /rkyen gyis drangs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /'du byed rtag tu phrag dog yin/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /srid pa kun 'byung thams cad du/ /'dod chags zhe sdang rmongs ldan pa'i/ /sems can 'dod pa zhes byar bshad/ /dam tshig sna tshogs 'dra ba yis/ /mngon par phyogs las skyes 'bras bu/ /gnyis med ye shes chos rnams la/ /nga rgyal byed pa rmongs zhes bshad/ /de la phan tshun 'cher ba ni/ /zhe sdang zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /mtshan nyid 'dod chags zhen pa gzhan/ /ye shes thabs ni rdo rjer bshad/ /dga' ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod mchog /bud med bde mchog phun sum tshogs/ /gti mug zhe sdang 'dod chags dang / /rdo rje la dga' rtag par gnas/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /mi 'jigs bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /ma skyes pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /de nyid gshin rje mthar byed do/ /rnam shes min bdag chos rnams ni/ /don dam mi 'gyur dag gyur nyid/ /sems can kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /des na shes rab mthar byed rgyal/ /brjod med bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /ming dang gzugs la dngos po med/ /chos rnams kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /des na khyab bdag pad mthar byed/ /mi rtog bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni zhi ba'i dngos/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /des na gtso bo bgegs mthar byed/ /mi 'jigs rnam par mi shes pa/ /brjod du med pa rtog bral ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /shes na bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ /gti mug zad phyir gshin rje gshed/ /des na lus mthar byed pa ste/ /des na shes rab mthar phyin 'gyur/ /nyes pa nyes pa longs spyod pas/ /nyes zad phyir ni shes mthar phyin/ /des na sems can mthar byed de/

/des na nyon mongs mthar phyin 'gyur/ /'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas/ /'dod chags zad pas pad mthar phyin/ /des na chags pa mthar byed de/ /de bzhin snyoms 'jug mthar byed 'gyur/ /nyon mongs kun zad gang yin dang / /de bzhin las ni thams cad zad/ /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni/ /bgegs mthar byed ces bya bar gsungs/ /nyon mongs rdo rje'i sgrib dag na/ /las rnams thams cad rnam par dag /las rnams thams cad rnam dag pas/ /las skyes 'bras bu rnam par dag /gzung dang chags pa nyid dang ni/ /rnam pa de bzhin mi g.yo ba/ /rgyu nyid 'bras bu nyid dag ste/ /drug las thugs ni kun tu 'byung / /'dod pa'i rgyal po la sogs drug /khro bo'i rgyal po rnam par grags/ /dam tshig rdo rje la sogs drug /sa la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa grags/ /rig pa'i rgyal po zhes bshad do/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs drug /rdo rje dbang po zhes bshad do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /bdag nyid chen po kun tu 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gzugs/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngags par sbyor bar nges byas la/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /'jigs pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /dgos pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags pas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /'di la mi bya ci yang med/ /de bzhin mi za yod ma yin/ /smra bar mi bya cung zad med/ /rtag tu mi bsam ci yang med/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du mnyam par zhog /gang gi sems kun la spyod pa/ /kun tu spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ /rkyen gyis gang gang 'byung ba yid/ /yid de man zhes bya bar bshad/ /tra ni skyobs par byed pa'i don/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bar/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rdo rje kun gyis bsrungs pa ni/

/sngags kyi spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /rang rang gi ni ngo bo nyid/ /snying po yid kyis rnam bsams te/ /gsang sngags bzlos pa'i dbye ba yi/ /zlos par byed cing spro zhing bsdu/ /sangs rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bdag /ye shes sa bon dag gis spro/ /byang chub bdag med sa bon gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bdag med gzung / /sna tshogs bzhin du sna tshogs so/ /dus gsum sa bon dag gis bzla/ /bzlas pa smra bar grags pas na/ /ngag kun bzlas pa zhes bshad la/ /sngags kun bod pa zhes bshad de/ /de nyid bskul bar smra ba 'o/ /ji ltar thugs sogs byin rlob pa/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang de bzhin no/ /de rnams spyi bor dbang bskur dang / /de bzhin kun tu mchod pa 'o/ /rdo rje 'chang ba gang yin pa'i/ /rig pa spyod pa'i sbyor ba dang / /bdag byin rlabs sogs de bzhin te/ /de yi longs spyod bzhir shes bya/ /dpa' bo rdo rje gcig rnams kyi/ /spyi bor dbang bskur re re ste/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags tsam dang / /rang rigs rigs kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab cing / /'bras bu la yang rgyu rgyas gdab/ /bsgom gyi gzhan du dngos grub ni/ /bskal pa bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /longs spyod bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /gru gsum du ni rnam par bsgom/ /kun nas ser ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu de dbus rnam par bsgom/ /rtsibs kun la ni khro bo bcu/ /ye shes bdag nyid bcu las byung / /'gog pa'i rdo rjes bsgom bya zhing / /mchog tu mdzes pa bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro bas/ /mi g.yo ba dang mtshungs par 'khor/ /de ltar chos 'byung ye shes ni/ /rang bzhin dri ma med zhi ba/ /bsgoms pas skad cig nyid kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni rab tu 'byung / /rdo rje can gyis der ston pa/

/rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim nyid dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'o/ /bsgrub pa dang ni nan tan dang / /dam tshig de bzhin sdom pa rnams/ /sngar ni de kun rgyas par ni/ /rim pa'i dbye bas phye ba yin/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs 'dod pa ni/ /bde sdug gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs/ /rtag tu snying las skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod la 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /rdo rje 'dra bar rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bzhin du dam tshig shes/ /'dod pa de rnams dam tshig mtshungs/ /rnam bcas dang ni rnam pa med/ /kun 'gro'i yi ge gsum bdag nyid/ /bya ba dang ni dbrog pa dang / /spro dang rang gis bzlas pa dang / /de ltar zhe sdang gti mug dag /sa gsum du ni bskyed par bya/ /gsang ba dag pa rgyas gdab cing / /rdo rje can gyi don byed do/ /zhe sdang sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zhe sdang 'khor lo bskyed nas su/ /rdo rje drag pos bcom nas ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bsdus/ /de ni spro bas bsdu byas la/ /de bzhin slar yang bsdu bar bya/ /'di lta'i sbyor bas bsgom byas na/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /khams gsum na ni ma lus pa/ /gsad pa de bzhin gso ba dag /khams gsum du ni khyad par du/ /skad cig gis ni byed par ni/ /mngon du bzhugs pa the tshom med/ /gti mug sbyor bas rnal 'byor pas/ /gti mug 'khor lo bskyed nas ni/ /rgyan la sogs pa gang ci'ang rung / /de dag thams cad rtag tu brku/ /gti mug sems kyi rgya mtsho bsgom/ /rin chen kun gyis rab tu dgang / /gti mug 'khor lo can kun gyis/ /sbyin pa'i char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /rdzas rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /rab tu sbyin dang dbreg pa nyid/ /sems kyi rdo rje brtag pa yis/ /skad cig tsam gyis byed par 'gyur/ /'dod chags sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'dod chags 'khor lo bskyed nas ni/

/lha mo thams cad phrogs nas su/ /'dod pa'i sbyor bas 'dod pa spyad/ /dga' sdug bde ba rangs pa yis/ /'dod pa'i rtse mos rnam par 'phrul/ /de ni 'khor lo can kun la/ /lha mi rab tu dbul bar bya/ /khams gsum dag tu byung ba yi/ /lha dang lha min chung ma yang / /skad cig tsam gyis 'dod spyod na/ /mi yi bu mo smos ci dgos/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur dang / /las mchog gi ni tshogs rnams kun/ /nyams su len cing byin rlobs pa/ /grub pa'i bgrod pa gzhan yin no/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor zhes grags dang / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa/ /gsum po dkyil 'khor yin par gsungs/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams ni/ /phyag rgya thams cad rgyas gdab pa'o/ /des ni brtag par rgya dgod pa/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni bstan pa bzhin/ /lcags kyu dbyug to rtse gsum pa/ /ral gri mtshams su rnam par dgod/ /'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs mi g.yo/ /steng du 'khor lo 'og gnod mdzes/ /rig rgyal rdo rje can rnams kyi/ /'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi brgya/ /sa la sogs pa sems dpa' yis/ /phyag rgya rang gi dkyil 'khor la/ /me long pi wang dung dang ni/ /de bzhin snod dang sna tshogs ras/ /chos 'byung ba yi phyag rgya drug /rdo rje'i bdag po rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khro rgyal rnams kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /de las gzhan yang dpa' bo gcig /rigs kyi kha dog dag gis brtag /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams/ /me tog ces ni bshad pa yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /rigs kyi rim pas bgod par bya/ /mchod rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bzhugs gnas pho brang yin par bshad/ /ye shes sems dpa' gang reg pa/ /ye shes 'khor lo zhes bshad do/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum yi ge /sa bon yi ge gnas zhes bshad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi de nyid ni/

/sad par bya ba bskul bar bshad/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /'od zer 'gyed pa stong pa yin/ /rdo rje can kun spyan 'dren pas/ /rdo rje can kun spyan drangs pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi gnas de yi/ /'od zer gyi ni rdo rje kun/ /bsdu nas gong bu'i tshul gyis so/ /bcings pa bcings pa yin par bshad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs ni rgyas btab ste/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /dbang bskur dbye ba rnam gsum du/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu brtag /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste/ /de yang bzhi pa de bzhin no/ /mig yangs sngags kyi snod du rung / /me tog bcas shing sa bon 'byung / /blangs nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /sngags pas slob ma dag la sbyin/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyis dbus gnas par/ /dri chu rkang dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje pad ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje can kun yang dag bsdu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /de dag thams cad snying kar bsdu/ /rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas su/ /slob ma'i khar ni dbab par bya/ /'di ni gsang sngags de kun gyi/ /dbang bskur ba yi go 'phang mchog /las chog gi ni tshogs rnams dang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dad cing shes rab che/ /gzugs bzang sgrub pa po la dga'/ /sbyor ba cig gis bya ba goms/ /dam tshig dag gi dam tshig can/ /bla ma la ni slob ma yis/ /yon rnams rab tu phul nas ni/ /bla mas de ni byin rlabs te/ /sgrub pa po la sbyin par bya/ /rmongs pa gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dag dang yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun ni dbang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhe sdang sdang ba'i bdag nyid sbyor/ /zhe sdang dga' dang yang dag ldan/

/zhe sdang rgyun gyi dbang bskur nas/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chags pa 'dod chags bdag nyid sbyor/ /'dod chags dga' dang yang dang ldan/ /'dod chags rgyun gyi dbang bskur na/ /'dod chags rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /shes rab ye shes bdag nyid sbyor/ /rdo rje dga' dang yang dang ldan/ /ye shes rgyun gyi dbang bskur na/ /shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rig pa'i lha mo de gnyis ni/ /rdo rje can gyi slob mas blang / /lag par lag pa bzhag nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dbang byas la/ /slob ma'i mgo bor lag bzhag ste/ /bla ma rdo rje can gyis bsgo/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas 'di ni rig pa'i mchog /chos kun gnyis su med pa la/ /dngos po gnyis su brtags pa yis/ /de bas 'khor bar rnam par bral/ /khyod kyis bral bar mi bya 'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o/ /rmongs pa gang gis 'das gyur na/ /de yis dngos grub mchog mi 'grub/ /tha mal lus kyi chos la ni/ /dri ma lnga rnams snang ba ni/ /ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs pas/ /bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya bar bshad/ /sbar ba nyid dang bsreg pa dang / /snang bar bya dang gzugs snang ba/ /sngags kyi lus su rab spyod pas/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje hūm̐ las phyung bar ni/ /bar snang la gnas bsam par bya/ /a las byung ba'i pad ma ni/ /de yi 'og tu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /de yi dbus su mtshan par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas/ /'bar bas rnal 'byor tshim par bya/ /shel dang mtshungs par snang 'gyur zhing / /ye shes nyi ma bzhi bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams ni/ /mtshon cha mchog gis drangs nas ni/ /bdud rtsi de ru phab nas kyang / /bza' ba'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ /bsgrub bya'i dngos grub cho ga yis/ /de bzhin dpa' bo lnga rnams bza'/

/yig gsum sa bon las skyes bya/ /gzhan du de ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ /tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid sgrub sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa yin/ /thabs ni rnam pa bzhi po dag /byang chub rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni thams cad du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag par bsngags/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang po ste/ /nye bar bsgrub pa gnyis pa yin/ /bsgrub pa yang ni gsum pa yin/ /sgrub pa chen po bzhi pa'o/ /thun mong mchog gi bye brag gis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi thun mong ste/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /dang po stong nyid byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa sa bon bsdus pa yin/ /gsum pa gzugs nyid rdzogs pa ste/ /bzhi pa yi ge dgod pa 'o/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi 'di dag gis/ /tha mal sgrub pa bsnyen pa bya/ /mchog ni ye shes bdud rtsi nyid/ /sbyor ba drug gis bya ba ni/ /bsnyen pa yan lag drug gis ni/ /byas pa sgrub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /gzhan du sgrub par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub mchog ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog dang rtsol dang de bzhin 'dzin/ /rjes su dran dang ting 'dzin te/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu bshad/ /dbang po bcu po rnams kyis kyang / /rang gi 'jug gnas thams cad du/ /'dod pa so sor bsdud pa na/ /so sor bsdud pa zhes brjod do/ /'dod pa lnga ni mdor bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas lnga ru sbyor ba yis/ /brtags pa bsam gtan zhes bshad de/ /bsam gtan de ni rnam lngar 'gyur/ /rtog dang dpyod dang dga' ba dang / /de bzhin bde ba nyid dang yang / /sems kyi rtse gcig nyid dag ste/ /lnga po der ni bsam gtan bsdu/ /gsang ba'i rgyud ni thams cad du/ /rnam pa du mar yongs bshad pa/ /gsang gsum byung ba rtog pa ste/ /de yi longs spyod spyod pa 'o/

/dga' dang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /bde bas bsdus pa bzhi pa 'o/ /shes dang shes bya byung zad pa'i/ /rang sems lnga par shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos zhi ba ni/ /'dod pa kun la rab tu gnas/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ /'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /sna yi rtse mor rab tu brtag /rin chen kha dog sna lnga ba/ /srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/ /rang sngags snying gar bsam nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler gyur par bzhag /rang dbang rin chen dgag pa yi/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa yin par bshad/ /sems ni 'gog pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /mtshan mar nyer 'dzin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i khams ni rnam pa lngar/ /byang chub rdo rjer gsungs pa yin/ /smig rgyu 'dra ba dang po ste/ /du ba lta bu gnyis pa yin/ /mkha' nang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /mar me 'bar 'dra bzhi pa yin/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu ni/ /rtag tu snang ba lnga pa 'o/ /brtan gyur rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /nam mkha'i khams su spro bar bya/ /rjes dran gang zhig rnam bsgom pa/ /de dang 'dra bar spro bar bya/ /rjes su dran pa zhes bshad de/ /so sor snang ba de las skyes/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /gong bu'i tshul gyis bsdus nas ni/ /dbus su gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /yud kyis ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes bya bar bshad/ /so sor bsdud la snyoms 'jug na/ /sngags rnams thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /bsam gtan ye shes snyom 'jug na/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par 'gyur/ /srog dang rtsol ba nges par ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzigs/ /rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'jug /rjes dran mnyam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin dbang 'gyur tsam gyis ni/ /sgrib pa rnam par bral bar 'gyur/

/snying po de ni thugs ka ru/ /zla ba rdo rje sbyor bas blta/ /mtshon mchog gis ni drangs nas ni/ /sems ni sngags kyi dngos byas te/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyi tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub tshig bcad brjod par bya/ /cho ga yang dag sbyor goms pas/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor la gnas te/ /sems de ye shes gzugs kyi ni/ /bsgom pa nye bar bsgrub pa 'o/ /ji srid mthong ba de srid du/ /rnam gnyis zla ba drug tu bsgom/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /thams cad du ni rtag tu bya/ /gal te zla ba drug gis ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa ma mthong na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga dang / /sdom pa lan gsum brtsam par bya/ /de byas kyang ni sgrub pa po/ /mthong ba 'byung bar ma gyur cing / /gang tshe byang chub ma grub na/ /drag shul gyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /de tshe de yi ye shes ni/ /'grub pa nges pa nye bar 'byung / /rigs kyi dbye ba'i sbyor ba ni/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab par bya/ /de nas dbang du bya ba dang / /bsrung ba'i sbyor ba dag kyang bya/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul nyid kyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo can rnams bsdu/ /lha mo dgu la spros nas su/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i lus la dgod/ /yongs su gyur las phyag rgya bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor der ni brtag par bya/ /bdag nyid dbus su bsams nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor der ni brtag par bya/ /bdag nyid dbus su bsam nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor can kun bsdu bar bya/ /thams cad rdo rje dngos byas la/ /de tshe byang chub bsgom par bya/ /sprul pa'i glu dbyangs bzhi yis ni/ /lha mo'i snying po bskul ba yis/ /dus gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin sems/ /ye shes lta bur lus bsgom mo/ /drags pa kha dog rnam par dbye/ /de bzhin gnyis kyi snying po ste/ /dbang bskur ba ni rang gi rgyu/ /bzhi yis 'bras bu phye ba yin/ /gsang sngags kyis ni phyed 'gyur la/ /rig pa'ang chos kyi phyag rgyas so/

/'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po drug /gtsug tor zhes ni rnam par grags/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po longs spyod zhi/ /rig pa'i rgyal po zhes byar grags/ /de bzhin rdo rje bdag po rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad ces byar bshad/ /bsam gtan rdo rje thams cad la/ /dbang skur gyis ni sngags pa ste/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ye shes lus dang lhan cig tu/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yis/ /gnyis su med par byed sgrub pa/ /sngar bshad pa yi rim gyis ni/ /rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /bdag dang 'dra bar dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad do/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su gtsug tor che/ /sbyor ba gnyis ka gzugs su dmigs/ /nye bar bsgrub pa'i dus su ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzugs kyi bar/ /sngags kyi cho ga shes pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i lha yi sbyor bar bya/ /sgrub pa chen po'i dus su ni /gtso bo sangs rgyas bdag po'i sku/ /'di ni rdo rje can kun dang / /rnal 'byor mchog gi gsang ba che/ /de lta'i rnam dbye shes byas nas/ /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan du bskal ba bye bar ni/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa rnams kyis kyang / /dngos grub mchog ni zhi ba dag /nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bsgrub bya sgrub par yang dag sbyor/ /gang yin de ni bsnyen par bshad/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /nye bar sgrub pa zhes bshad do/ /yi ge hūm̐ dang phaṭ ldan pa/ /bskyod pas bsgrub pa zhes bshad la/ /ngo bo nyid bzhi rang dbye ba/ /sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad do/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs las byung / /de nyid chos rnams chos nyid do/ /las dang rjes su mthun gang gis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sbyor ba dmigs/ /dkyil 'khor de dang de bskyed na/ /dam tshig mi zad bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/

/dam tshig dang por bsgrub par bya/ /de nas gtsug tor dam tshig ni/ /cho ga ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /las dang gang gang rjes mthun pas/ /rang gi 'khor lo'i bka' yang bsgo/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la gang yin pa'ang / /dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgoms nas su/ /de yi lus gnas 'khor lo la/ /de yi nyes pa bsgrag par bya/ /de nas de rnams de bcom nas/ /byung bar gyur par rnam bsgoms na/ /dngos po kun gyis drangs nas ni/ /de ni rang gi 'khor lor gzhug /ji ltar gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /khro bas khyab pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rkang pas mtshan ma mnan par bya/ /de yi bka' nod khro bo ni/ /sna tshogs tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams/ /bsgrub pa rdo rje can gyis ni/ /bsgrub bya gsad phyir gtang par bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos de bskor nas/ /de ni bcing zhing brdeg pa dang / /de nas brdung zhing skrag gyur pa/ /sgrub pa pos ni dgug pa dang / /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags kyis ni/ /de yi gzugs brnyan la phab nas/ /sngags pas rdo rje dag gis ni/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /phur pa'i sngags kyis phur bu gdab/ /yams dang nye bar 'tshe ba kun/ /sna tshogs yul las byung ba rnams/ /gzugs de la ni phab nas su/ /rdo rje rnams kyi phur bus gdab/ /de nas sbyor ba thams cad kyis/ /cho ga ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /'khrul 'khor sngags kyi sbyor ba sogs/ /las kyi dbye bar sbyar bar bya/ /mtshan ma mnan nas bzlas pa 'am/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg gam/ /bsgom pas gdug pa'i sems can gyis/ /zos par gyur par rab tu brtag /zhi la zhi ba'i sems kyis bya/ /rgyas la rgyas pa'i yid kyis te/ /dbang la chags pa'i yid du bya/ /khro la gtum pas rab tu sgrub/ /ces pas bstan/ de nas ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa'i the tshom sel ba'i dris lan bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa ni/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis the tshom thams cad bcad par mdzad nas/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje la bzhugs par rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bstod cing / slar yang dri ba gsol ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis bstod do/ /thams cad sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad thugs khyod phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thams cad mdzod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /sku gsung thugs ni thob 'gyur bas/ /sems can sangs rgyas mi mnyam mnyam/ /bsgrub bya su yis bsgrub pa gang / /sgrub pa'i dbang po bdag nyid che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gsad pa yis/ /ji ltar sdig pas gos mi 'gyur/ /gal te gos 'gyur 'bras bu gang / /zhes pas bstan/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la legs so sngon du 'gro bas dris lan bka' stsal ba ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sems dpa' chen po legs so legs/ /bdag nyid chen po legs so legs/ /gsung dbyangs chen po legs so legs/ /mchod pa chen po legs so legs/ /slob dpon byang chub rdo rje can/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /dngos rnams thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ /skyed dang bsdu bar mdzad pa po/ /des na de ni sdig mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams dag kyang de bzhin no/ /gang la sdig dang bsod nams med/

/de ni byang chub yin par gsungs/ /mgon po de yi bslu ba yis/ /las can thams cad 'jig mdzad kyang / /ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /byang chub dang ni rnyed mi dka'/ /sngon ni mi zad las byas pa/ /gal te dmyal ba rnams su ni/ /skye bo skye 'gyur de rnams kyi/ /dmyal ba rnams ni 'bras bu che/ /byang chub snying rjes bsgrub bya 'di/ /ye shes sems ni rgyas btab pas/ /sems can rnams la sbyor ba des/ /mchog tu phan btags shes par bya/ /tshar gcod pa yang rjes bzung las/ /bdag nyid chen po de yis bya/ /sgrub pa chen po'i mthar thug par/ /byas nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa la legs so phul ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams/ rdo rje can gyi thugs rdo rje chen po'i tshul gyis chos thos pas dga' zhing rab tu dga' dang yang dag par dga' ba'i yid kyis legs so zhes bya ba gsol te/ mgon po chen po legs so legs/ /thub pa chen po legs so legs/ /e ma ho kun tu bzang po yis/ /thugs rje chen po dri ma med/ /gdug pa mi zad las kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'bras bu stsol/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsang ba 'dus pa'i che ba gsungs pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i gsang ba 'dus par dbang bskur ba'i sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya zhing skrag par 'gyur bar mi 'gyur bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub rdo rje las byung ba/ /zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pa/ /sngags kyi rgyun ni bsdus pa dag

/yongs su spang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mgrin gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod do/ /dus gsum rdo rje'i thugs yin srid dang mthar thug gang / /zhi zhing sgrib med nam mkha' dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnam rgyal byang chub dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /de la lus ngag yid kyis rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nges dang 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang / /rig pa'i spyod pa las byung rtag tu rab 'brel bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spro dang dga' dang rnam pa de bzhin mi 'gyur dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes rtogs chos/ /rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib pa rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thogs med rnam dag dngos po 'di bsgom pa/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung spros dang rnam par bral/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur brtul zhugs dam tshig sbyor la brtag /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rjes grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di bsgom zhing / /bsnyen pa'i cho ga nye bar sgrub dang bsgrub pa dang / /bsgrub pa chen po blo mi 'gyur ba'i sgrub pa po/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig thun bzhi'i rdo rje dag ni sgrub byed pa/ /mi snang la sogs sna tshogs mchog dang dman grub cing /

/bla ma'i drin gyis 'di na ma nor lam rtogs pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyan pa dang / /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang / /mchod pa byed pa dang ni 'bri ba'am 'brir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang du zhi sogs las tshogs shin tu brtags pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor sngags bshad dang ni de bzhin rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya yid dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i dbang po ni/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi gtso bo sgrub pa po mthong reg pa dang / /legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang / /dad par byed cing phyogs 'dzin tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstan/ de ltar 'khor gyi bstod pa la ston pa rnams dgyes shing / kun kyang rjes su yi rang ba'i tshul sogs ston pa la/ bstod pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /'dres pa kun la bstod pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mchod chen la/ /mgon po de dag rjes yi rang / /'dus pa gsang ba las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rgyud kun bdag po'i dbang po yis/ /rgyud 'di legs par gsungs pa yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsungs nas/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la zhugs te/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rang ga la/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa le'u'i ming ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las gsang ba thams cad ston pa rdo rje ye shes kyis byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa rdzogs so/

/zhes pas bstan/ da ni rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'di nyid rgya gar 'phags yul gyi skad las bod skad du bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i lo paṇa bka' drin can rnams la rjes 'jug rnams byas shes drin so bskyed pa'i phyir bsgyur cing smos pa ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tsar+ya shra ta kā ra war ma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ de yan gyis de ltar byung ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub dngos bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig gi tshogs/ /rgyud sde gzhan las zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /dpal ldan bsdus pa'i rgyud 'grel khog phub 'di/ /bshad la zhing skyong dbang po dgyes gyur cig /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa zhar las 'ong ba rgyud bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye bstan pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i rgyud 'chad pa la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye byed tshul/ bdag gi rje bla ma rnams 'di ltar gsungs te/ rgyas par na bla ma gong ma'i rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ sa bcad sogs gsung rab chen po dag gi gzhung dang sbyar ba'i tshig don mtha' dag mi lus pa 'chad pa ni rab yin la/ 'bring du na sa bcad dang / gzhung gi tshig yongs rdzogs sam thog mtha' sbyar ba'i khog phub kyi bshad pa 'di lta bu byed pa'am/ yang na rgyud kyi lung rgyun sngon la byas nas/ sa bcad dang gzhung gi tshig zur sbyar ba tsam zin thun du byed pa ni 'bring gi 'chad tshul yin la/ bsdus pa'i lugs ni gzhung la sa bcad sbyar ba bklags lung du byas te/ gal che ba rnams la mchan bu'i steng nas bshad pa thar tsam byas pas kyang rgyun mi nub cing / bshad bka' thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mngon rtogs dka' 'grel las/ gzhung gi don rnams ni mchan du legs par btab la/

zhes dang / bshad pa mang po ni gsang sngags dam tshig gi rgyud yin pas 'chol bar 'gyur la/ zhes dang / rje btsun rin po che'i gsung las kyang de 'dra ba mang du byung bas so/ /gzhan yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi kye rdor gyi rgyud bshad gnang dus kyi gsung rgyun zin bris dag las kyang / bla chen 'phags pa la rgyud bshad thob pa mang du yod kyang / yongs su rdzogs pa dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal yin la/ khong dbus kyi dga' ldan du rgyud gsum gyi 'chad nyan la bskos nas/ hor rgyal pos rgyud 'dzin lnga brgya tsam la rgyun du 'tsho ba sbyar/ bkra shis dpal gyi dngos slob na bza' brag phug pa la/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud gsan dus/ dka' sa tsho la bshad dum tsam dang / gzhan rnams la lung gtso bor mdzad nas bshad bkar 'gro ba tsam gsan te brgyud pa yang brag phug pa nyid la 'ded par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / zhwa lu bu ston gyis kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bshad gsan dus kyang / 'phags 'od kyi gsung las/ khyed lta bu la rgya ba'i rgya lugs dang / gar ba'i gar lugs nas dgos pa'i lugs min/ gzhung dang 'brel pa tshor bshad de bklags la skabs skabs su 'gag 'ga' re tsam bshad de chos thob che ba rang byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa bu ston nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi bshad thabs gsang ba sgo 'byed las 'byung ngo / /'di dag kyang rgyud bshad rgyas bsdus kyi rnam dbye shes pa la phan pa'i rtsod bral kyi gsung rgyun du shes par bya'o/ /gang ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi 'chad tshul gsum ka la rgyud gzhung dbu zhabs yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang / de'i tshad ldan gyi 'grel pa bla ma brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las 'ongs pa'i lung rgyun nges par bya dgos shing / yang sa bcad dang gzhung sbyar ba'i bshad pa logs su ma byung yang / rgyud kyi gzhung dang /

'grel pa tshad thub gang rung zhig gi lung thob kyang bshad bka'i rgyun thob par 'gyur ba bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed pa lags pas rjes 'jug dpyod ldan rnams kyi dgongs par mdzod/ de rnams kyis zhal las 'ong ba rgyud bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye mtha' dag bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud kyis bshad bka' mi nub gnas pa'i thabs/ /gong ma'i phyag len ngo mtshar ma mthong bas/ /rgyud bshad ces pa'i sgra la'ang snying 'dar ba'i/ /thos chung rnams kyis smad par ma gyur cig /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar de dag gis ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa gsang 'dus bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ zab yangs dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud rgyal che/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs 'di ru/ /bshad nyan sgo nas rgyas mdzad skyes mchog rnams/ /bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi 'o/ 1 /rang nyid skyes sbyangs blo gros dmus long yang / /rgyud kyi bshad bka' chad la nye ba 'di/ /sems kyis ma bzod bstan pa'i khur blangs nas/ /mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed de bshad/ 2 /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa'i 'gro kun gyis/ /bcas dang rang bzhin gyis bsdus nyes ltung tshogs/ /ji tsam bsags pa ma lus byang gyur cig 3 /de la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dbang po gsal/ /bstan pa'i bya ba yid la re ba bzhin/ /mtha' ru phyin nas don gnyis lhun grub shog 4 /phyi ma bde ba can nam mngon dga' sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du dpon slob kun 'dzoms te/ /rang rgyud grol nas gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rgyas byed shog 5 /'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel khog phub 'di bshad pas/

/'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i 'chad nyan sogs/ /'dus pa'i bstan pa phyogs 'dir rab rgyas nas/ /'dus pa'i chos kun srid mthar gnas gyur cig 6 /da ni rang nyid na tshod cher yol bas/ dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa'i khur chen po/ /'di nyid rigs dang chos las skyes pa yi/ /slob tshogs rnams kyis 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis/ /ji srid bstan pa rin chen gnas kyi bar/ /de srid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /kha ba ri ba'i dbyig 'dzin ma lus pa/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pas khyab gyur cig 8 /nam yang shes bya'i mtha' la thug med cing / /mi rtag 'chi ba'ang nam 'ong cha med pas/ /dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa rnams/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgom snyam gcig tu sems/ 9 /bshad tshogs gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i legs bshad kyis/ /chos kun gtan la dbab par ci mkhas kyang / /rkyen ngan byung tshe phan par mi gda' bas/ /sgrub la dril ces rang la rang gis gdam/ 10 /de ltar sngon chad so skye bdag 'dra yis/ /chags sdang rmongs pas mi tshe stong zad bskyal/ /'on kyang bslu med bla mas rjes bzung bas/ /ci byas bstan 'gro'i don du gyur snyam sems/ 11 /de phyir kho bo'i rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams/ /snyom las ma byed gong ma'i gsung rab la/ /thos dang bsam pas sgro 'dogs legs bcad nas/ /bshad sgrub gang la'ang thogs med gdengs thob mdzod/ 12 /gzhan yang brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs bsten nas/ /mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus shes bya'i gnas/ /kun la ngom pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan par mdzod/ 13 /de nas bsnyen sgrub la sogs mthar phyin nas/ /blo mchog rnams kyi bstan pa spel ba dang / /blo gros dman yang rang nyid sgrub pa la/ /gcig tu dril na dal 'byor don yod lags/ /14 kun rdzob rten 'brel spyir yang 'char ba'i dngos/ /dngos de'i rang bzhin gdod nas brjod bral ngang /

/ngang du shes 'di sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /mchog rnams bzhed pas lta ba'i skyong tshul yin/ 15 /de de'i ngang nas bsgom bya sgom byed dang / /'dzin bya 'dzin byed bral bar mnyam bzhag ste/ /spyod lam kun tu sgyu mas rgyas btab na/ /grol rgyu med pa'i sems 'di grol bar 'gyur/ 16 /ngo mtshar tshul 'di bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /sngon chad kho bos go yul tsam du rtogs/ /da ni ji bzhin rgyud la myur 'byor nas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rol par rtogs gyur cig 17 /ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa gsang 'dus bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i mgon po dang rnam dbyer med pa'i sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi spyan ldan lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ sa skya'i gser chos kyi mnga' bdag nyams rtogs kyi gter chen chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ sdom brtson dam pa mkhas grub sbyin pa grags pa/ snyigs dus kyi bstan 'dzin kun gyi rgyan gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mkhan chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa la sogs pa ste yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus pas blangs pa la brten nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gsum gyi smin byed kyi dbang grol byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid de'i rgyab rten rgya bod kyi glegs bam du ma'i bshad lung dang kun gyi bstan gzhir gyur pa gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/

rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i le'u bco brgyad pa dang / de'i 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba zla ba grags pas mdzad pa gnyis lo chen gyi bsgyur/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i gsang ba sgo 'byed dang / 'grel bshad mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa'i steng nas rgyud kyi bshad bka' lung dang bcas pa don gnyer che ba las kyang ches che bar bgyis pa la brten legs par nos pa'i skal ba bzang po can dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon gyi mkhas pa gong ma mang po'i gsung rab la brten nas/ rang gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag lnga dang nyag ma bzhir slebs pa/ rgya gar skad du bi ka ra ste rnam 'gyur zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la lcags pho stag gi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar cha rak+ta bzhed pa'i bzang po'i gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing / skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen rab mchog dang ldan pas snyan ngag sogs rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/ ak+ṣa ra'i 'du byed la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa/ mtsho sgo ba mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjes dad pa dang brtson 'grus bla na med pa'i sgo nas mgyogs par bgyis pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig smras pa/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel khog phub 'di/ /'bri dang klog dang thos bsam 'chad nyan sogs/ /bgyid pa rnams la bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /chos 'di spel ba tsa turmu kha zhal bzhi pas mdzod/ /dharme ud da ya mastu chos 'di dar bar gyur cig/ ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/

shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ dge bar gyur cig skye 'gro rnams/ sarba maṃṅga laṃ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
